stem:
A solicitor is employed by a firm of solicitors that is regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) and is an ‘exempt professional firm’ for the purposes of financial services. The firm is not authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority. The solicitor is acting for a woman who is considering buying one of two neighbouring plots of farmland.

The woman would like advice on which of the two plots she should purchase and the solicitor refers the woman to a chartered surveyor who is ‘tied’ to a particular land agent. The woman selects, and decides to proceed with the purchase of, one plot of land on the basis of the advice she receives from the chartered surveyor. Neither the solicitor nor the firm receive a commission or other benefit as a result of referring the woman to the surveyor. The firm and the solicitor comply at all times with the SRA Financial Services (Conduct of Business) Rules and the SRA Financial Services (Scope) Rules.
stemZh: 律师受雇于SRA监管的律所；律所属于金融服务豁免专业机构，但未获FCA授权。客户考虑购买两块相邻农地中的一块。律师将客户转介给与某土地代理机构有绑定关系的特许测量师，客户根据测量师意见选定土地。律师及律所未收取转介佣金或其他利益，并始终遵守SRA金融服务规则。
ask: Which of the following statements best describes why the solicitor is not in breach of the general prohibition under s.19 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000?
askZh: 律师为何不违反FSMA 2000第19条的一般禁止？

options.en: The plot of land is not a specified investment.
options.zh: 该土地不是指定投资。

options.en: The solicitor is not acting in the course of business.
options.zh: 律师并非在业务过程中行事。

options.en: The solicitor can take advantage of the authorised third party exclusion.
options.zh: 律师可以利用获授权第三人的排除规则。

options.en: The solicitor can take advantage of the introducing exclusion.
options.zh: 律师可以利用介绍业务的排除规则。

options.en: The solicitor’s advice is exempt as the firm is regulated by the SRA.
options.zh: 律所受SRA监管，因此律师的建议获得豁免。

explanation.topic: Specified investment · 指定投资
explanation.zh: 选A。先判断活动是否涉及 **specified investment**。直接购买本题农地不属于该类指定投资，因此无须先依靠题干中的金融服务排除或专业机构豁免。
explanation.ruleZh: 先检查投资及活动是否受监管，再考虑排除和豁免。
explanation.warning: 土地本身与以土地为底层资产的投资产品不同；不能把本题结论扩展到所有房地产投资安排。

A.zh: 直接土地购买不是本题的指定投资，未进入所述受监管活动范围。

B.zh: 律师显然在提供职业服务，不能说不在业务过程中。

C.zh: 不必以第三人获授权作为本题理由，而且题干未说明测量师获FCA授权。

D.zh: 不能因发生转介便自动适用介绍业务排除。

E.zh: SRA监管不是对一切金融服务活动的全面豁免。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 先检查投资及活动是否受监管，再考虑排除和豁免。

warning.zh: 土地本身与以土地为底层资产的投资产品不同；不能把本题结论扩展到所有房地产投资安排。

stem:
A painter goes to a shop, which has been trading for several years, for the first time. The painter hires a set of ladders and signs a collection slip setting out the agreed period and costs. After making payment and as he leaves the shop he sees a notice on the shop wall (‘the Notice’) which states:

“No liability is accepted for defective products hired.”
stemZh: 油漆工第一次到一家已经营多年的商店租梯子。他签署了载明租期与费用的取货单并付款。离店时才看到墙上告示：“对租出的有缺陷产品不承担责任。”
ask: Does the Notice form part of the contract between the painter and the shop for the hire of the ladders?
askZh: 该告示是否成为梯子租赁合同的一部分？

options.en: No, because the contents of the Notice are not incorporated into the contract.
options.zh: 没有，告示内容未订入合同。

options.en: Yes, because the Notice constitutes reasonable notice of its terms.
options.zh: 有，告示已对条款作合理通知。

options.en: Yes, because the painter agrees to the terms of the Notice by signing the collection slip.
options.zh: 有，签取货单即同意告示条款。

options.en: Yes, because having traded for several years, the shop will be able to prove a consistent course of dealing.
options.zh: 有，商店经营多年即可证明一贯交易过程。

options.en: No, because the Notice constitutes a mere representation.
options.zh: 没有，因为告示只是陈述。

explanation.topic: Incorporation by notice · 通知订入
explanation.zh: 选 A。墙上写着“有缺陷的出租产品一概不负责”，不等于这句话自动成为租梯子合同的内容。商店应在订约前或订约时合理告知画工这项免责条款。本题中，画工签好取货单、付完钱，离店时才看到告示，已经太迟，因此商店不能把它作为本次合同的条款。
explanation.ruleZh: Notice 须及时；course of dealing 要看双方此前交易。

A.zh: 订约之后才出现的通知不能据此订入既有合同。

B.zh: 不仅要合理通知，还要通知及时，本题不满足。

C.zh: 取货单没有载明或援引该告示，签单不等于接受墙上所有内容。

D.zh: 需要双方之间的一贯交易；商店经营年限不等于双方交易历史。

E.zh: 告示意图免责，问题在于没有及时订入，不是单纯陈述。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 为什么要看告知的时间？
reasoningSteps.detail: Incorporation by notice指通过告知，让某项条款成为双方合同的内容。顾客在决定是否订约时应有合理机会知道这些条件；商店不能等合同成立后，再单方面补上一项免责要求。

reasoningSteps.title: 签了取货单，是否就接受墙上告示？
reasoningSteps.detail: 取货单写了租期和费用，但题目没有说单上包含或援引墙上的告示。画工签署这张单据，不能因此推定他也接受了另一处告示中的免责内容。

reasoningSteps.title: 为什么“商店经营多年”没有帮助？
reasoningSteps.detail: 依靠course of dealing，需要证明这位画工与这家商店过去有稳定、一致的交易做法。他是首次到店，因此商店不能靠自己的经营年限来证明双方早已同意该条款。

textbookReferences.chapter: 第6章 · 免责条款与不公平条款
textbookReferences.section: Incorporation by signature / reasonable notice / consistent course of dealing
通过告知、签字或既往交易将条款纳入合同

textbookExample.title: 教材例6.3：入住后才见到告示
textbookExample.facts: 旅客在前台办理入住并付款，进入房间后才看到酒店限制失窃责任的告示。
textbookExample.lesson: 教材以Olley案说明：合同在前台已成立，房间告示出现太迟。
textbookExample.connection: 本题把前台换成租梯子商店；关键同样是通知相对于订约的时间。

points.zh: 商店想让墙上的免责告示成为合同的一部分，应当在订约前或订约时采取合理措施告知顾客。本题签单付款后才看到告示，通知已经太迟。
这里看的是同一商店与同一顾客过去是否经常按相同条款交易。商店经营多年，只说明开店时间长；画工第一次来，双方没有这种交易历史。

stem:
Four chartered surveyors set up together in business as a Limited Liability Partnership (‘the LLP’). Two of them are designated members and two are ordinary members of the LLP and all work full time. The members all meet formally once a month to discuss profit and loss, cash flow and financial forecasts. This financial information has indicated for the past 12 months that the LLP is unable to pay its debts. The LLP has continued in business, and the members have discussed ways of limiting costs. As a result they have made considerable reductions in office expenditure. At one meeting (‘the Meeting’) a few months ago, one of the ordinary members (‘the Ordinary Member’) suggested that they should obtain financial and/or legal advice on their position. This suggestion was rejected on the basis that it would be too expensive.

A liquidator is appointed on the insolvent winding up of the LLP. The liquidator considers it clear that at the date of the Meeting there was no reasonable prospect that the LLP would avoid insolvent liquidation and is considering whether to bring a claim for wrongful trading against all the members.
stemZh: 四名特许测量师组成LLP，两名指定成员、两名普通成员均全职工作，并每月讨论财务与预测。过去12个月资料显示LLP不能清偿债务。成员继续经营并削减办公成本。数月前，一名普通成员建议获取财务或法律意见，但被其他成员以费用太高为由否决。LLP后来进入资不抵债清算；清算人认为开会时已无合理希望避免该结局，拟对所有成员提出wrongful trading请求。
ask: Which of the following must the Ordinary Member show to establish a defence against a claim by the liquidator?
askZh: 该普通成员须证明什么才能成立抗辩？

options.en: That he took all reasonable measures to reduce expenditure incurred by the LLP.
options.zh: 采取一切合理措施降低LLP支出。

options.en: That as he is not a designated member he benefits from limited liability and cannot be required to contribute to the assets of the LLP.
options.zh: 非指定成员有有限责任，因此不能被要求补充资产。

options.en: That he took every step to minimise the potential loss to the LLP’s creditors.
options.zh: 采取每一项措施尽量减少LLP债权人的潜在损失。

options.en: That it was reasonable for the LLP to continue trading in the expectation that the LLP’s business would recover.
options.zh: 相信业务会恢复而继续经营是合理的。

options.en: That as he is not a designated member he did not have access to all information necessary to decide whether the business was insolvent.
options.zh: 非指定成员无法获得判断资不抵债所需的全部信息。

explanation.topic: Wrongful trading · 不当持续经营
explanation.zh: 选C。达到无法合理避免资不抵债清算的节点后，核心抗辩是采取 **every step** 尽量减少债权人潜在损失。节省办公费或提议咨询，只是可能相关的措施，未必足够。
explanation.ruleZh: 抗辩重点是 every step to minimise creditor loss。
explanation.warning: 有限责任不是不当持续经营的绝对保护；也不能把提出一次建议视为自动免责。

A.zh: 削减开支范围过窄，不等同于尽量减少债权人损失所需的每一步。

B.zh: 普通成员身份不使其自动免受wrongful trading责任。

C.zh: 准确对应法定抗辩的要求。

D.zh: 题干已给出无合理希望避免清算的判断，泛称会复苏不足。

E.zh: 所有人按月获取财务信息，普通成员身份不是缺乏信息的当然证明。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 抗辩重点是 every step to minimise creditor loss。

warning.zh: 有限责任不是不当持续经营的绝对保护；也不能把提出一次建议视为自动免责。

stem: To progress a case before the court, the correct interpretation of a section in a statute is required and the judge considers his options under the rules of statutory interpretation. He decides to use the mischief rule.
stemZh: 法院需要解释某项成文法条文，法官决定采用mischief rule。
ask: Which of the following best describes how the judge will use the mischief rule in interpreting the statute?
askZh: 法官会如何运用该规则？

options.en: He will consider the defect in common law which caused Parliament to pass the statute.
options.zh: 考虑促使议会立法的普通法缺陷。

options.en: He will select an interpretation of the statute which addresses any initial absurdity.
options.zh: 选择能消除初步荒谬结果的解释。

options.en: He will refer to the record kept by parliamentary drafters who worked on the statute.
options.zh: 查阅负责该法的起草人员记录。

options.en: He will give to the words of the statute their ordinary and grammatical meaning.
options.zh: 按法律文字的通常语法含义解释。

options.en: He will make use of an academic textbook as an external aid to interpretation.
options.zh: 使用学术教材作为外部解释辅助。

explanation.topic: Mischief rule · 弊害规则
explanation.zh: 选A。Mischief rule关注旧法存在什么缺陷、立法旨在补救什么问题，并据此解释条文。
explanation.ruleZh: Mischief＝旧法缺陷；literal＝通常文义；golden＝避免荒谬。
explanation.warning: 区分解释方法与解释时可能使用的材料。

A.zh: 着眼于旧法弊端及立法补救目的，符合该规则。

B.zh: 主要对应golden rule对荒谬结果的修正。

C.zh: 起草记录不等于mischief rule的定义。

D.zh: 主要对应literal rule。

E.zh: 外部辅助材料的使用不是mischief rule本身。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Mischief＝旧法缺陷；literal＝通常文义；golden＝避免荒谬。

warning.zh: 区分解释方法与解释时可能使用的材料。

stem:
A woman is driving her car along a road when she sees the warning light indicating low engine oil light up. The woman stops the car at the side of the road and turns on the car’s hazard warning lights.

A passing motorist (‘the Motorist’) sees the woman’s car and stops to offer his assistance. The Motorist has some spare engine oil and the woman agrees that he should pour some of this into the woman’s car engine.

The oil warning light turns off and the woman assumes therefore that the car is fixed. She drives off but within 20 minutes her car engine seizes up, causing considerable damage to the car.

A garage carries out the repairs to the woman’s car. She is told that the Motorist has used the wrong type of engine oil and this has caused the engine damage.

The woman wishes to bring a claim in negligence against the Motorist. She seeks advice from a solicitor who believes that there are no similar precedents or comparable cases by which to establish whether the Motorist owes the woman a duty of care. The solicitor’s legal advice about what the court will consider is based on this belief.
stemZh: 女性驾车时机油警示灯亮起，停车并开启双闪。路过的驾驶人主动帮忙，经同意加入自备机油。警示灯熄灭，她继续开车，20分钟内发动机卡死。维修厂确认使用错误机油导致损坏。她拟诉帮助者过失；律师认为没有类似或可比先例，并以此作为建议前提。
ask: What legal advice will the solicitor provide about what the court will consider when deciding whether the Motorist owes a duty of care in negligence to the woman?
askZh: 法院判断帮助者是否负有注意义务时，会考虑哪些因素？

options.en: Solely whether the Motorist could reasonably foresee that harm would be caused to the woman’s property.
options.zh: 仅考虑能否合理预见财产损害。

options.en: Solely whether the Motorist has a relationship of proximity with the woman and whether it is fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty on him.
options.zh: 仅考虑关系接近性及施加义务是否公平、公正、合理。

options.en: Solely whether the Motorist could reasonably foresee that harm would be caused to the woman’s property and whether he has a relationship of proximity with her.
options.zh: 仅考虑可预见性及关系接近性。

options.en: Whether the Motorist could reasonably foresee that harm would be caused to the woman’s property, whether he has a relationship of proximity with her and whether it is fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty on him.
options.zh: 考虑可预见性、关系接近性，以及是否公平、公正、合理。

options.en: Solely whether it is fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty on the Motorist to the woman.
options.zh: 仅考虑施加义务是否公平、公正、合理。

explanation.topic: Novel duty of care · 新型注意义务
explanation.zh: 选D。在题设明确没有可适用类似先例的前提下，需综合考虑损害的合理可预见性、proximity，以及施加注意义务是否fair, just and reasonable；其余选项都遗漏要素。
explanation.ruleZh: 新型义务：foreseeability＋proximity＋fair, just and reasonable。
explanation.warning: 并非所有过失案都重新机械套三步；本题特别说明无类似先例，才以新型义务作为分析前提。

A.zh: 可预见性单独不足。

B.zh: 遗漏可预见性。

C.zh: 遗漏公平、公正、合理这一判断。

D.zh: 完整列出本题新型义务分析的三个方面。

E.zh: 单一政策判断不能取代其余要素。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 新型义务：foreseeability＋proximity＋fair, just and reasonable。

warning.zh: 并非所有过失案都重新机械套三步；本题特别说明无类似先例，才以新型义务作为分析前提。

stem:
A limited company (‘the Claimant’) supplies bike stands at a cost of £15,000 including VAT to a sole trader (‘the Defendant’) who sells electric bikes. The Defendant is VAT registered. The Defendant fails to pay the amount due.

The Claimant instructs a solicitor who obtains a money judgment in the County Court for the full sum plus interest. The Defendant does not pay the judgment debt within 14 days as ordered by the court.

The Claimant accurately informs the solicitor that the Defendant rents a very expensive apartment, her business is doing well and she also leases an industrial unit where she sells and stores all of her stock. She also pays money monthly into a bank account in the joint names of her and her spouse which has a current balance of £30,000.
stemZh: 公司向经营电动自行车业务的个体商户供应含VAT价£15,000的车架；商户已登记VAT但未付款。公司取得County Court的全额及利息判决，被告未在14日内清偿。被告租住昂贵公寓，业务良好，在租赁的工业单元存放商品，每月向与配偶联名的银行账户存款；该账户余额£30,000。
ask: What is the best method of enforcing the judgment to recover some or all of the judgment debt?
askZh: 追回全部或部分判决债务的最佳执行方式是什么？

options.en: A warrant of control.
options.zh: County Court控制令（warrant of control）。

options.en: An attachment of earnings order.
options.zh: 工资扣押令。

options.en: A charging order over the apartment.
options.zh: 对公寓设立押记令。

options.en: A third party debt order.
options.zh: 第三人债务令。

options.en: A writ of control.
options.zh: High Court控制令（writ of control）。

explanation.topic: Enforcement · 判决执行
explanation.zh: 选E。可针对被告拥有的营业存货执行；本题金额超过£5,000，适合转由High Court签发 **writ of control**。她是个体经营者，公寓为租赁，账户又与配偶联名，其他选项均有明显障碍。
explanation.ruleZh: 执行方式须匹配债务人身份、资产归属与判决金额。
explanation.warning: 只能针对债务人拥有且可依法执行的财产；租赁厂房本身不是她的财产。

A.zh: 本题金额不适合通过County Court warrant处理，应用High Court writ路径。

B.zh: 个体经营收入不是可向雇主扣押的工资。

C.zh: 题干未表明被告拥有公寓权益，租住不等于拥有产权。

D.zh: 仅对被告一人的判决不能据此扣押她与非判决债务人配偶的联名账户。

E.zh: 可对其自有可执行存货采取控制及出售措施。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 执行方式须匹配债务人身份、资产归属与判决金额。

warning.zh: 只能针对债务人拥有且可依法执行的财产；租赁厂房本身不是她的财产。

stem:
A solicitor working in a large firm becomes aware that a client whom she is representing in the purchase of a property is involved in money laundering.

She makes a disclosure to the nominated officer at the firm. The nominated officer considers the information provided with the disclosure and agrees that there is evidence of money laundering.
stemZh: 律所律师发现购房客户涉及洗钱，向所内指定负责人报告。负责人审查后同意存在洗钱证据。
ask: To whom must the nominated officer report the evidence of money laundering?
askZh: 指定负责人必须向谁报告？

options.en: The National Crime Agency.
options.zh: National Crime Agency（NCA）。

options.en: The Law Society.
options.zh: Law Society。

options.en: The Solicitors Regulation Authority.
options.zh: SRA。

options.en: The Financial Conduct Authority.
options.zh: FCA。

options.en: The solicitor acting for the seller of the property.
options.zh: 卖方律师。

explanation.topic: SAR · 可疑活动报告
explanation.zh: 选A。向内部nominated officer报告后，由负责人依适用反洗钱义务向 **NCA** 作出对外披露；SRA或Law Society不是这一SAR的接收机关。
explanation.ruleZh: 内部报告给 nominated officer；对外SAR报 NCA。
explanation.warning: 内部升级报告与外部法定披露是两步，不要把它们混为一谈。

A.zh: NCA是相应可疑活动报告的主管接收机关。

B.zh: Law Society不是SAR接收机构。

C.zh: 监管报告与向NCA的洗钱披露不同。

D.zh: FCA不是本题的报告接收机关。

E.zh: 向交易对方律师披露可能引发另行风险，不履行这项法定报告义务。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 内部报告给 nominated officer；对外SAR报 NCA。

warning.zh: 内部升级报告与外部法定披露是两步，不要把它们混为一谈。

stem:
A man visits a solicitor. The man informs the solicitor that he is a director of a company (‘the Company’) in which he is also employed. He explains that the Company is wholly owned by a US company (‘the Parent’), and that all the other directors of the Company are officers of the Parent and reside in the USA. The man resides in England.

The man explains that the Parent has requested that the Company purchases a particular property in London (‘the Property’) from which the Company will operate to expand its existing business.

The man further explains that the board of directors of the Company (‘the Board’) has met to consider the Parent’s request and has resolved to proceed with the purchase of the Property as they have determined that such a purchase would promote the success of the Company. The solicitor is asked to advise on the purchase of the Property.
stemZh: 一名居住英格兰的公司董事兼员工找律师。公司由美国母公司全资持有，其余董事均为住在美国的母公司管理人员。母公司建议该公司购买伦敦物业扩展业务；该公司董事会已开会，认为交易促进公司成功并决议购买，现请律师提供购房建议。
ask: Which of the following statements best explains who is the solicitor’s client?
askZh: 谁是律师的客户？

options.en: The Parent, because the Company is wholly owned by it.
options.zh: 母公司，因为它全资持有该公司。

options.en: The man, because he is the director of the Company who is resident in England.
options.zh: 该男子，因为他是住在英格兰的董事。

options.en: The Company, because it is the Company that will be purchasing the Property.
options.zh: 该公司，因为它是物业买方。

options.en: The Parent, because the Parent requested that the Company purchase the Property.
options.zh: 母公司，因为它提出购买要求。

options.en: The Board, as it has resolved to proceed with the purchase of the Property.
options.zh: 董事会，因为它作出购买决议。

explanation.topic: Client identity · 公司客户识别
explanation.zh: 选C。委托事项是公司的购房交易，董事在公司授权下传达指示。公司具有独立身份，不能将母公司、董事或董事会直接当成客户。
explanation.ruleZh: 公司委托：识别法人客户与有权传达指示的人。
explanation.warning: 股东、集团母公司、董事和公司本身可能有不同利益，不能混用其身份。

A.zh: 全资持有不消除子公司的独立身份。

B.zh: 负责接洽的董事不因此成为个人客户。

C.zh: 本题的交易主体和接受服务主体均为该公司。

D.zh: 提出集团要求不等于母公司成为委托人。

E.zh: 董事会是公司的决策机关，不是此处的独立客户。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 公司委托：识别法人客户与有权传达指示的人。

warning.zh: 股东、集团母公司、董事和公司本身可能有不同利益，不能混用其身份。

stem:
A woman owned a pet shop which she ran as a sole trader. She decided to sell the pet shop and become a partner in a dog grooming salon which has been operating for a number of years. When the woman joined the partnership, she took out a loan of £10,000 at an annual interest rate of 10% to purchase her partnership share. The loan is still outstanding in full. In the 2025/26 tax year the woman’s share of partnership profits was £38,000.

It took longer than the woman anticipated to find a buyer for the pet shop but she completed the sale on 6 April 2025 making a profit on the sale of £10,000.

In 2025/26 the personal allowance is £12,570 and the basic rate of Income Tax is 20%. The basic rate tax band is £0 - £37,700.
stemZh: 女性原以个体经营者身份经营宠物店，后加入经营多年的宠物美容合伙。她为购买合伙份额贷款£10,000，年利率10%，本金仍全额未还；2025/26年度分得合伙利润£38,000。宠物店于2025年4月6日售出，出售收益£10,000。题设个人免税额£12,570，基本所得税率20%，基本税带£0–£37,700。
ask: What is the woman’s liability for Income Tax in the 2025/26 tax year?
askZh: 她2025/26年度应缴多少所得税？

explanation.topic: Income Tax · 合伙利润与借款利息
explanation.zh: 选A。按题设，购买合伙份额的合资格贷款利息为£1,000。应税所得＝£38,000−£1,000−£12,570＝£24,430；乘20%为£4,886。出售业务的资本收益不混入这里的所得税计算。
explanation.ruleZh: 所得税：利润−合资格利息−个人免税额，再按税带计税。
explanation.warning: 按题目指定的2025/26年度和数值计算；资本利得税是否产生是另一问题。

B.zh: 遗漏£1,000利息减免，多计£200税款。

C.zh: 把£10,000资本收益并入所得税且漏扣利息。

D.zh: 虽扣了利息，却错误将资本收益并入所得税。

E.zh: 不符合题设税基及扣除项目的计算。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 所得税：利润−合资格利息−个人免税额，再按税带计税。

warning.zh: 按题目指定的2025/26年度和数值计算；资本利得税是否产生是另一问题。

stem:
A recruitment company wishes to buy a small kettle from a retail company (‘the Retailer’) for the use of its employees.

When the office manager of the recruitment company first visits the Retailer’s premises the kettle is not in stock. The Retailer therefore orders one from the wholesalers and the office manager later returns to the Retailer to collect it.

After being used twice the kettle does not work.
stemZh: 招聘公司为员工购买小电水壶。办公室经理第一次到零售商处时无现货，零售商向批发商订购后，经理返回领取。水壶使用两次就坏了。
ask: What claim does the recruitment company have?
askZh: 招聘公司可提出哪项请求？

options.en: The kettle is not of satisfactory quality under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
options.zh: 违反CRA 2015的满意质量要求。

options.en: The kettle is not fit for particular purpose under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
options.zh: 违反CRA 2015的特定用途适用性要求。

options.en: The kettle is not of satisfactory quality under the Sale of Goods Act 1979.
options.zh: 违反SGA 1979的满意质量要求。

options.en: The kettle is not fit for particular purpose under the Supply of Goods (Implied Terms) Act 1973.
options.zh: 违反Supply of Goods (Implied Terms) Act 1973的特定用途要求。

options.en: The kettle is not of satisfactory quality under the Supply of Goods and Services Act 1982.
options.zh: 违反SGSA 1982的满意质量要求。

explanation.topic: Business buyer · 企业购买货物
explanation.zh: 选 C。合同的买方是招聘公司，不是个人消费者，所以这里应使用SGA 1979的货物买卖规则。该法要求经营者出售的货物具有satisfactory quality。水壶只使用两次就不能工作，显然涉及正常功能和耐用性问题。员工自己使用水壶，不会把公司的采购变成个人消费者购买。
explanation.ruleZh: 先识别买方身份；公司买水壶也可能是B2B。

A.zh: 公司不是CRA 2015的消费者，选错法。

B.zh: 同样选错CRA，且本题直接指向一般质量缺陷。

C.zh: 企业买卖及使用两次即坏的事实对应SGA满意质量条款。

D.zh: 该法主要涉及相应分期租购等安排，本题是普通买卖。

E.zh: 普通货物买卖在本题适用SGA，而非该供货及服务路径。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 先识别买方身份
reasoningSteps.detail: 购买人是招聘公司；员工使用水壶，并不会把法人买方变成CRA意义上的个人消费者。

reasoningSteps.title: 选择法律及义务
reasoningSteps.detail: 这是货物买卖，适用SGA 1979的法定默示质量义务。不是服务合同，也不是本题所述1973年法路径。

reasoningSteps.title: 把缺陷用于规则
reasoningSteps.detail: 水壶仅用两次就不能工作，支持不具满意质量的请求；选C。零售商先从批发商订货不改变买方与零售商的合同。

textbookReferences.section: Terms implied by statute in the B2B regime；Table 5.3
Sale of Goods Act 1979与Consumer Rights Act 2015

points.zh: 先看谁是买方。公司为员工购买水壶，买方仍是公司；水壶属于日常用品，并不会让公司取得个人消费者的身份。
货物应达到合理买方可以期待的质量，包括正常使用和合理耐用性。本题水壶只用两次就坏了，支持违反这项义务的请求。

stem:
A government department has recently been created to tackle the rising terrorist threat in the UK. The civil servants working within the new department (‘the Staff') are involved in the handling of secret material relevant to national security, and have been selected from existing civil service employees. All the Staff brought into the new department were existing members of the largest national civil service trade union (‘the Union’).

Six months into their new posts, after an escalation in industrial action by some civil service trade unions, the Staff are told that they have been banned from being members of the Union with immediate effect. No consultation with either the Staff or the Union has taken place. The Union did not participate in the recent industrial action. The Staff wish to bring a claim under the Human Rights Act 1998, alleging that their Article 11 rights to freedom of assembly and association, as enshrined within the European Convention on Human Rights, have been infringed.
stemZh: 新设政府部门处理反恐及国家安全机密，调入人员原来均属全国公务员工会。六个月后，在其他公务员工会罢工升级背景下，部门未协商即禁止员工继续加入该工会；该工会没有参与罢工。员工希望依据HRA 1998主张ECHR第11条集会结社自由受到侵犯。
ask: Which of the following statements represents the best advice to the Staff about the protection offered by Article 11?
askZh: 关于第11条保护，哪项建议最佳？

options.en: Article 11 rights are qualified rights whose exercise may be subject to restrictions which are imposed in the interests of national security.
options.zh: 这是qualified right，可为国家安全目的受到限制。

options.en: Article 11 rights are limited rights whose exercise may be subject to restrictions which are imposed in the interests of the social and economic well-being of the country.
options.zh: 这是limited right，可为国家社会经济福祉受到限制。

options.en: Article 11 rights are absolute in respect of the right of the individual to form and join trade unions for the protection of their own interests.
options.zh: 个人组建和加入工会的权利绝对不受限制。

options.en: Article 11 rights are qualified rights and consultation is a necessary condition for any restriction on the right to form and join trade unions to be deemed proportionate.
options.zh: 这是qualified right，但协商是任何工会限制合比例的必备条件。

options.en: Article 11 rights are limited rights and are not subject to restriction when exercised by the armed forces, the police or the administration of the state.
options.zh: 这是limited right，军队、警察和国家行政人员行使时不受限制。

explanation.topic: Article 11 · 集会结社自由
explanation.zh: 选A。第11条属于 **qualified right**，允许为国家安全等合法目的依法、必要且合比例地限制。承认限制的可能性，不等于认定本次一律禁令已满足全部条件。
explanation.ruleZh: Qualified right：合法依据＋许可目的＋必要性与比例性。
explanation.warning: 选A只说明可限制；政府仍须证明具体措施符合要求，不能以“国家安全”四字自动胜诉。

A.zh: 正确指出权利性质及国家安全这一许可目的。

B.zh: 误将权利分类为limited，列举理由也不准确。

C.zh: 组建和加入工会受保护，但不是绝对权利。

D.zh: 协商可能相关，却不能表述为所有限制合法性的无例外前提。

E.zh: 第11条明确容许对军队、警察或国家行政人员施加合法限制。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Qualified right：合法依据＋许可目的＋必要性与比例性。

warning.zh: 选A只说明可限制；政府仍须证明具体措施符合要求，不能以“国家安全”四字自动胜诉。

stem:
A claimant issues a claim for breach of contract against a defendant. The defendant fails to serve its defence within the time limit required and the claimant enters judgment in default of a defence.

The defendant applies to set aside the default judgment and the application is heard in the County Court before a District Judge at a hearing centre outside London.

The District Judge refuses to grant the application. The defendant is granted permission to appeal and appeals against the order made by the District Judge.
stemZh: 合同诉讼被告未及时提交答辩，原告取得缺席判决。被告向伦敦以外的County Court申请撤销，由District Judge审理并驳回。被告已获上诉许可，现就该命令上诉。
ask: Who will hear the defendant’s appeal?
askZh: 谁将审理上诉？

options.en: High Court Judge in the High Court.
options.zh: High Court中的High Court Judge。

options.en: Circuit Judge in the County Court.
options.zh: County Court中的Circuit Judge。

options.en: Justices of Appeal in the Court of Appeal.
options.zh: Court of Appeal法官。

options.en: Master in the County Court.
options.zh: County Court中的Master。

options.en: District Judge in the High Court.
options.zh: High Court中的District Judge。

explanation.topic: Appeal route · 郡法院上诉路径
explanation.zh: 选B。按本题普通County Court民事程序，District Judge的一审决定通常上诉至County Court的 **Circuit Judge**，不是直接到Court of Appeal。
explanation.ruleZh: 通常路线：County Court District Judge → Circuit Judge。
explanation.warning: 先确定作出决定的法院、法官级别及是否存在特别程序；不要只凭“上诉”就选Court of Appeal。

A.zh: 不是本题通常适用的上诉目的地。

B.zh: 对应County Court District Judge的通常上诉路线。

C.zh: 跨越了本题通常的上诉层级。

D.zh: Master并非此处County Court上诉审理职位。

E.zh: 不是本题规定的上诉路线。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 通常路线：County Court District Judge → Circuit Judge。

warning.zh: 先确定作出决定的法院、法官级别及是否存在特别程序；不要只凭“上诉”就选Court of Appeal。

stem:
A woman owns premises from which she runs her business of providing spa facilities and beauty treatments to the public. A customer was injured whilst using one of the showers in the spa when several tiles fell off the shower wall onto her feet.

The shower had been recently refurbished by independent contractors specialising in installing commercial spa facilities. They had been recommended by the woman’s experienced surveyor who inspected and approved the completed works.

The tiles fell off the wall because the independent contractors used inadequate tile adhesive to fix the tiles to the wall.
stemZh: 女性经营水疗及美容场所，顾客淋浴时墙砖掉落伤脚。淋浴区由专业商业水疗安装承包商刚装修，承包商经她有经验的测量师推荐，完工后又经测量师检查批准。事故因承包商使用不合格瓷砖胶引起。
ask: Which of the following best describes the woman’s potential liability under the Occupiers’ Liability Act 1957?
askZh: 依据OLA 1957，她最可能承担何种责任？

options.en: She is not liable because she reasonably engaged competent contractors and had the work checked afterwards.
options.zh: 不负责，因为合理聘用合资格承包商且事后检查工程。

options.en: She is not liable because the independent contractors had control over the premises when the negligent work was carried out.
options.zh: 不负责，因为施工时承包商控制场地。

options.en: She is liable because the customer was a visitor to the premises.
options.zh: 负责，因为受害人是访客。

options.en: She is liable because the woman and the independent contractors are both occupiers.
options.zh: 负责，因为她与承包商都是占有人。

options.en: She is liable because the tiles are a danger on the premises.
options.zh: 负责，因为掉落墙砖属于场地危险。

explanation.topic: Independent contractors · 独立承包商
explanation.zh: 选A。对于施工类危险，占有人若合理委托有能力的独立承包商，并采取合理步骤核查资质及工程，可依OLA 1957第2(4)(b)条避免就该缺陷承担责任。本题推荐与专业验收直接支持该判断。
explanation.ruleZh: 独立承包商：合理委托＋合理核查能力及工程。
explanation.warning: 聘请承包商本身不是自动免责；本题关键是专业推荐和完工验收。

A.zh: 合理委托、资质与完工检查均有事实支持。

B.zh: 施工时由承包商控制不当然消除经营者的占有人责任。

C.zh: 访客身份触发注意义务，却不意味着严格责任。

D.zh: 即使可能有多个占有人，也须分别判断是否违反义务。

E.zh: 存在危险及损害不自动证明经营者违反合理注意义务。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 独立承包商：合理委托＋合理核查能力及工程。

warning.zh: 聘请承包商本身不是自动免责；本题关键是专业推荐和完工验收。

stem:
A paralegal has been employed for 18 months at a law firm. She appeared as a witness in a colleague’s successful claim under the Equality Act 2010 (‘the Act’) against the firm at the Employment Tribunal. The paralegal and the colleague continue to work for the firm after the claim concluded.

A few months later, the firm pays a discretionary bonus to staff in their salary to thank them for their hard work that financial year. The paralegal and the colleague do not receive a bonus unlike all other staff. They are the only employees to have been involved in Employment Tribunal proceedings against the firm. The paralegal raises the matter with her line manager but with no success, which leaves her feeling humiliated.

The paralegal seeks advice on whether she can bring a claim under the Act for the failure to pay her the discretionary bonus.
stemZh: 律师助理已在律所工作18个月，曾为同事针对律所提出的Equality Act 2010诉讼出庭作证，该同事胜诉，两人之后仍留任。几个月后，律所向全体其他员工发放酌情奖金，唯独这两名参加过相关诉讼的员工未获奖金。助理向主管反映无果，并感到受辱，现咨询能否依据该法起诉。
ask: Is the firm likely to be in breach of its duties under the Act by not paying the paralegal the discretionary bonus?
askZh: 律所不发奖金是否可能违法？

options.en: No, as the bonus is at the firm’s discretion only and not a contractual term.
options.zh: 不违法，奖金属酌情决定而非合同权利。

options.en: Yes, there is a likely claim of direct discrimination.
options.zh: 违法，可能构成直接歧视。

options.en: Yes, there is a likely claim of victimisation.
options.zh: 违法，可能构成victimisation。

options.en: Yes, there is a likely claim of harassment.
options.zh: 违法，可能构成harassment。

options.en: No, as the paralegal has not worked at the firm for two years.
options.zh: 不违法，她工作未满两年。

explanation.topic: Victimisation · 因受保护行为遭不利待遇
explanation.zh: 选C。为Equality Act诉讼提供证据属于 **protected act**。因该行为受到不发奖金的不利待遇，可构成victimisation；无需证明本人具备某项受保护特征，也不要求两年工龄。
explanation.ruleZh: Protected act＋because of it＋detriment → victimisation。
explanation.warning: 不要把victimisation、直接歧视与harassment混为一类。

A.zh: 酌情奖金的决定仍须遵守平等法。

B.zh: 题干联系的是参加平等法程序，而非因某受保护特征而区别对待。

C.zh: 作证是受保护行为，因之不给奖金是所指不利待遇。

D.zh: 感到受辱不足以使本题最佳分类变成骚扰；关键是对作证的报复。

E.zh: 两年门槛不是这项Equality Act权利的要求。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Protected act＋because of it＋detriment → victimisation。

warning.zh: 不要把victimisation、直接歧视与harassment混为一类。

stem: Three solicitors set up in partnership six months ago. They shared profits equally and ran their business from an office owned personally by one of the partners which he bought seven months ago. The partner who owned the office has now died. At the date of his death, the partnership business was valued at £900,000 and the office was valued at £700,000.
stemZh: 三名律师六个月前合伙开业，平均分享利润，使用其中一名合伙人七个月前以个人名义购买的办公室。该合伙人刚去世，死亡时合伙业务价值£900,000，办公室价值£700,000。
ask: Which of the following best describes the availability of Business Relief (BR) for Inheritance Tax in respect of the deceased partner’s interest in the partnership business and in the office?
askZh: 其合伙权益及办公室能否享受遗产税Business Relief？

options.en: The interest in the partnership business and the office will both qualify for BR at a rate of 100%.
options.zh: 两者均享100%减免。

options.en: The interest in the partnership business will qualify for BR at a rate of 100% and the office will qualify for BR at a rate of 50%.
options.zh: 合伙权益享100%，办公室享50%。

options.en: The interest in the partnership business will qualify for BR at a rate of 100% and the office will not qualify for BR.
options.zh: 合伙权益享100%，办公室无减免。

options.en: The interest in the partnership business will not qualify for BR and the office will qualify for BR at a rate of 50%.
options.zh: 合伙权益无减免，办公室享50%。

options.zh: 两者均无减免。

explanation.topic: Business Relief · 最低持有期
explanation.zh: 选E。题干的合伙权益仅持有六个月，办公室仅持有七个月，均未达到通常两年的BR持有期，也没有给出替代资产等例外事实。应先检查资格，再讨论减免比例。
explanation.ruleZh: 先看是否满足通常两年持有期，再看资产类别与减免范围。

A.zh: 两项均未满足本题的最低持有期。

B.zh: 这些比例不能跳过持有期要求。

D.zh: 办公室不足两年，也不合资格。

stem:
A customer buys a television from a shopkeeper on 24 December. It is a gift for his daughter. He does not inform the shopkeeper that it is a gift for someone else.

When his daughter opens the box she discovers the television is defective. She travels to the shop on 26 December and asks for a replacement or refund. The shopkeeper refuses.
stemZh: 父亲12月24日向店主买电视送女儿，但未告诉店主这是给他人的礼物。女儿开箱发现电视有缺陷，12月26日到店要求更换或退款，遭拒绝。
ask: What advice should be given to the daughter?
askZh: 应如何告知女儿的合同权利？

options.en: The daughter has rights under the contract because she suffered a detriment in travelling to the shop.
options.zh: 她为去商店付出不利，因此有合同权利。

options.en: The daughter has rights under the contract because on an objective test the television was likely to have been purchased as a gift for a third party.
options.zh: 客观上电视很可能是送人的礼物，因此她有合同权利。

options.en: The daughter has a right under the contract to have the television replaced only.
options.zh: 她有合同权利，但只能要求更换。

options.en: The daughter has no rights under the contract because she was not a party to it.
options.zh: 她不是合同当事人，因此在本题没有该合同权利。

options.en: The daughter has no rights under the contract because it is a domestic agreement between members of a family.
options.zh: 这是家庭成员间的家庭协议，因此她没有合同权利。

explanation.topic: Privity · 未获识别的受赠人
explanation.zh: 选 D。与商店订立买卖合同的是父亲，女儿只是礼物的接受者。女儿要以自己的名义要求商店履行合同，需要符合第三人合同权利的例外。本题父亲没有告诉店主这是礼物，合同中也没有识别女儿或赋予她执行权，因此她不能仅凭收到电视就主张买方的合同权利。
explanation.ruleZh: 第三人：先找识别与赋权依据；受赠不等于取得买卖合同权利。

A.zh: 事后跑一趟商店不是与店主交换承诺所提供的对价。

B.zh: 节日前购物这一推测不能代替法定识别及赋权条件。

C.zh: 尚未建立女儿的合同请求权，无从限为仅可换货。

D.zh: 正确体现本题相对性及缺少适用例外的事实。

E.zh: 相关合同是父亲与商店的买卖，不是家庭内部协议。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 谁签订买卖合同
reasoningSteps.detail: 父亲与店主订约，女儿只是后来接受电视的受赠人；礼物本身不会转让全部合同权利。

reasoningSteps.title: 能否适用第三人例外
reasoningSteps.detail: 1999年法须满足第三人识别及可执行条款等条件。店主甚至不知是礼物，合同未以姓名、类别或描述识别女儿为受益第三人。

reasoningSteps.title: 为什么选D
reasoningSteps.detail: 女儿在本题合同下没有权利；她跑到商店的负担不自动成为与店主订约的对价。父亲作为买方的权利须另作处理。

textbookReferences.chapter: 第4章 · 合同相对性与第三人权利
textbookReferences.section: Privity；Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999；例4.2
第三人身份识别及1999年法的合同权利

textbookExample.title: 教材例4.2：被“前租户”类别识别的第三人
textbookExample.facts: 新租户与房东的合同明确把“任何前租户”的保证责任限制为£5,000。前租户可凭该类别描述援引条款。
textbookExample.lesson: 第三人不一定要被写出姓名，但须在合同中被适当识别，并满足法定执行条件。
textbookExample.connection: 本题从未向店主说明受赠人，缺少这种合同内的识别与授权基础。

points.zh: 原则上，买卖合同的权利由签约的买方享有。父亲把电视送给女儿，并不会自动把他对商店的全部合同权利也转给女儿。
第三人能否自己执行合同，要在合同中找到法定依据。本题店主不知道电视是送给女儿的，合同也没有识别或授权她；父亲作为买方仍可主张自己的权利。

stem:
During a visit to her uncle, a woman is badly bitten by his dog. Her finger is severed in the incident and she requires surgery to reattach her finger. She is advised by her doctor that it will not be possible to gauge whether the surgery has been successful for six months and a further operation may be needed. She will also require physiotherapy.

The woman gives careful thought to claiming compensation from her uncle. She concludes that she will pursue a claim.

The uncle wishes to avoid the costs and delay of court proceedings and would prefer that the claim is resolved now through alternative dispute resolution (ADR). The uncle puts forward a close friend who is suitably qualified to conduct a mediation. The uncle says that his friend has excellent qualifications and that they will not find anyone able to exercise better judgement. The woman is uncomfortable about the proposed appointment and is worried that she will not secure full compensation if she does not issue formal court proceedings. The woman decides that mediation is not appropriate and she would like to instruct a solicitor to issue proceedings.
stemZh: 女性探访叔父时被狗咬断手指，术后六个月才可判断重接是否成功，可能还需再手术及理疗。她决定索赔。叔父希望立即通过ADR解决，并选定自己的好友担任调解员，强调其专业资格出色。她担心独立性和赔偿是否充分，想委托律师起诉。
ask: Which of the following statements best explains why the woman should decline to participate in ADR as proposed by the uncle?
askZh: 拒绝叔父提出的这项ADR安排，最佳理由是什么？

options.en: The mediator will not be truly independent because he is a friend of the uncle and has been selected by him.
options.zh: 调解员是叔父朋友且由叔父选定，缺乏真正独立性。

options.en: The woman will have to be unrepresented in mediation and will not therefore have the benefit of legal expertise in presenting her case.
options.zh: 调解时她不能由律师代理。

options.en: The mediator has the authority to impose a settlement on the woman and she is concerned she will not receive full compensation.
options.zh: 调解员可强迫她接受和解。

options.en: The woman will be required to meet her own costs of mediation whereas she can recover all her costs if she is successful in court proceedings.
options.zh: 调解费用需自付，而诉讼胜诉可追回全部费用。

options.en: The costs of mediation are likely to be disproportionately high compared to the cost of resolving her claim through the court.
options.zh: 调解成本很可能比诉讼高得不成比例。

explanation.topic: Mediation · 调解独立性
explanation.zh: 选A。反对的是由对方单方选择其好友的具体调解安排，独立性受到质疑。调解通常允许法律协助，调解员不能像法官一样强制裁定，也不能假定诉讼必然收回全部费用。
explanation.ruleZh: 质疑特定调解员独立性，不等于任何ADR都不适当。
explanation.warning: 应区分调解与仲裁；调解员通常不作具有强制力的实体裁决。

A.zh: 直接对应题干的关系冲突及单方指定问题。

B.zh: 调解并不禁止律师协助或代表。

C.zh: 调解员促成协商，无权强迫一方接受和解。

D.zh: 诉讼胜诉不保证收回全部费用。

E.zh: 题干没有支持调解费用高于诉讼的事实。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 质疑特定调解员独立性，不等于任何ADR都不适当。

warning.zh: 应区分调解与仲裁；调解员通常不作具有强制力的实体裁决。

stem:
A local council introduces a ban on school‐age children entering coffee shops, shopping centres and cinemas between 8am and 6pm on school days. This decision is an attempt to reduce high levels of truancy in city centre schools. It is made under legislation giving local authorities full discretionary powers to introduce measures aimed at improving educational attainment and it is introduced without public consultation.

Local businesses are outraged by this decision and seek legal advice. Many of them rely on trade from local school children, and since school lessons finish by 3.30pm they cannot see how the ban until 6pm can be justified. No human rights issues are at stake.
stemZh: 地方议会根据改善教育表现的广泛自由裁量授权，未经公众协商，禁止学龄儿童在上学日8时至18时进入咖啡店、商场和影院，以减少逃课。商家认为学校15时30分就放学，限制至18时无法解释且损害业务；题干排除人权问题。
ask: Which of the following statements best summarises the basis on which this decision could be challenged through judicial review?
askZh: 以司法审查挑战该决定，最佳依据是什么？

options.en: If the decision does not give sufficient weight to the interests of the local businesses.
options.zh: 对商家利益权重不足。

options.en: If the decision does not result in a demonstrable improvement in educational attainment by local school children.
options.zh: 无法证明教育表现确有提高。

options.en: If the decision is one which is not the most cost effective in the circumstances.
options.zh: 并非成本最低的方案。

options.en: If the decision goes significantly beyond what local authorities are doing elsewhere to address the same issue.
options.zh: 明显超出其他地方政府的做法。

options.en: If the decision is so outrageous in its defiance of logic that no sensible person could have arrived at it.
options.zh: 违背逻辑到任何明智之人都不会作出该决定的程度。

explanation.topic: Wednesbury unreasonableness · 非理性
explanation.zh: 选E。在本题传统非理性审查路径下，要证明决定达到 **Wednesbury unreasonableness** 的高门槛；法院不只是因为另一个方案更好或权衡不同就替代行政判断。
explanation.ruleZh: Judicial review 审查合法性；Wednesbury 门槛远高于政策不佳。
explanation.warning: 本题排除人权因素，不要直接拿一般比例性审查替换所考的传统非理性标准。

A.zh: 单纯不同意利益权重通常不足以达到该门槛。

B.zh: 未达预期效果不自动说明决定违法。

C.zh: 司法审查不是替政府挑最便宜的政策。

D.zh: 与别处做法不同本身不构成非理性。

E.zh: 准确表达本题的高强度非理性标准。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Judicial review 审查合法性；Wednesbury 门槛远高于政策不佳。

warning.zh: 本题排除人权因素，不要直接拿一般比例性审查替换所考的传统非理性标准。

stem:
To fund a breach of contract claim a claimant enters into a damages based agreement with a firm of solicitors set at 20%. The claimant’s solicitors pay disbursements of £5,000. The action is settled. A settlement order is drawn up under which the defendant agrees to pay the claimant damages in the sum of £150,000 and agrees to pay the claimant’s solicitors’ costs of £10,000 plus disbursements of £5,000. The defendant pays the amounts due to the claimant’s solicitors.

The claimant’s solicitors calculate the amount they can deduct under the damages based agreement. The solicitors will remit the balance to the claimant.
stemZh: 原告与律所订立20%的damages based agreement。律所垫付支出£5,000。案件和解，被告同意赔原告£150,000，并支付律师费£10,000及支出£5,000，全部款项付至原告律师。律师按DBA扣除费用后将余款汇给原告。
ask: What sum will the claimant receive from his solicitors?
askZh: 原告应收到多少？

explanation.topic: DBA · 成果报酬与对方付费抵扣
explanation.zh: 选A。DBA报酬＝£150,000×20%＝£30,000。对方已支付£10,000律师费，应抵扣该报酬，故从赔款再扣£20,000；£5,000支出已另获偿付，不重复扣，原告收到£130,000。
explanation.ruleZh: DBA总报酬需扣除已收对方律师费；已偿付支出不再重复扣。
explanation.warning: 先分开赔款、对方律师费及代垫支出，再看律师可从赔款中扣多少。

B.zh: 直接扣30,000，漏抵对方支付的律师费。

C.zh: 既漏抵律师费，又重复扣已经偿付的支出。

D.zh: 错误把DBA百分比应用于律师费等而非相应赔偿基数。

E.zh: 不符合报酬计算及已收费用抵扣规则。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: DBA总报酬需扣除已收对方律师费；已偿付支出不再重复扣。

warning.zh: 先分开赔款、对方律师费及代垫支出，再看律师可从赔款中扣多少。

stem:
An adult man is killed in a car accident. A woman is liable in negligence for causing the accident and the man’s death.

The man was married at the time of his death and is survived by his wife and their one-year old son. The man is also survived by both his parents. The man’s wife, son and parents are all dependent on the man.

The man had made a will leaving all his estate to his wife and son.
stemZh: 成年男性因女性驾驶人过失造成的车祸死亡，留有妻子、一岁儿子及父母。妻儿和父母均依赖其收入。他遗嘱将全部遗产留给妻儿。
ask: Who is entitled to claim bereavement damages for the man’s death under the Fatal Accidents Act 1976?
askZh: 依据FAA 1976，谁有权请求bereavement damages？

options.en: The man’s parents only.
options.zh: 仅父母。

options.en: The man’s wife only.
options.zh: 仅妻子。

options.en: The man’s son only.
options.zh: 仅儿子。

options.en: The man’s wife and son only.
options.zh: 仅妻子和儿子。

options.en: The man’s parents, wife and son.
options.zh: 父母、妻子和儿子。

explanation.topic: Bereavement damages · 丧亲法定赔偿
explanation.zh: 选B。丧亲赔偿的法定受益范围，与经济扶养损失的dependants范围及遗嘱继承人范围不同。本题成年死者的妻子有权，儿子和父母不会仅因受扶养或继承遗产而获得该项赔偿。
explanation.ruleZh: Bereavement、dependency、estate claims 各有不同受益人。
explanation.warning: 问题只问bereavement，不是在问哪些人可能请求其他死亡损失赔偿。

A.zh: 成年死者的父母不因受扶养而取得该项权利。

B.zh: 本题妻子属于法定合资格人。

C.zh: 死者的子女不属于此处的丧亲赔偿受益类别。

D.zh: 妻子有权，但不能把儿子一并加入。

E.zh: 把扶养损失受益人范围误套到bereavement。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Bereavement、dependency、estate claims 各有不同受益人。

warning.zh: 问题只问bereavement，不是在问哪些人可能请求其他死亡损失赔偿。

stem: A woman does not make any disposals for Capital Gains Tax (CGT) purposes in the 2025/26 tax year. She made £2,000 losses for CGT purposes in the 2024/25 tax year.
stemZh: 女性在2025/26年度没有任何资本利得税意义上的资产处置。她在2024/25年度发生£2,000的资本亏损。
ask: Which of the following statements best describes the woman’s CGT position?
askZh: 哪项最准确描述她的CGT情况？

options.en: She can carry forward both her £2,000 losses and her 2025/26 annual exemption indefinitely until she has an opportunity to use them.
options.zh: 亏损及2025/26年度免税额均可无限结转。

options.en: She can carry forward her £2,000 losses indefinitely until she has an opportunity to use them and can carry forward her 2025/26 annual exemption to 2026/27 only.
options.zh: 亏损可无限结转，免税额只能结转至2026/27。

options.en: She can carry forward her £2,000 losses to 2026/27 only and can carry forward her 2025/26 annual exemption indefinitely until she has an opportunity to use it.
options.zh: 亏损只能结转至2026/27，免税额可无限结转。

options.en: She can carry forward her £2,000 losses to the 2026/27 tax year only and cannot carry forward her 2025/26 annual exemption at all.
options.zh: 亏损只能结转至2026/27，免税额不可结转。

options.en: She can carry forward her £2,000 losses indefinitely until she has an opportunity to use them and cannot carry forward her 2025/26 annual exemption at all.
options.zh: 亏损可无限结转，年度免税额不可结转。

explanation.topic: CGT losses · 亏损与年度免税额
explanation.zh: 选E。符合申报等条件的未用资本亏损可结转至以后年度使用；年度免税额只属于相应税年，未使用部分不能储存到下一年。
explanation.ruleZh: Capital losses 可结转；annual exempt amount 当年未用即失效。
explanation.warning: 可结转使用不等于无需在适用期限内申报亏损。

A.zh: 年度免税额不能结转。

B.zh: 年度免税额连下一年也不能结转。

C.zh: 亏损并非只存续至下一年，免税额也不能无限结转。

D.zh: 错误给亏损设了一年使用期限。

E.zh: 正确区分亏损结转与年度免税额。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Capital losses 可结转；annual exempt amount 当年未用即失效。

warning.zh: 可结转使用不等于无需在适用期限内申报亏损。

stem:
A woman (‘the Claimant’) instructs a solicitor to issue a claim for damages against a firm of financial advisers (‘the Defendant’) on the basis that it provided her with negligent advice when she was its client. The claim is valued in excess of £100,000.

The Defendant instructs a solicitor and a defence is filed and served. On the same day that the defence is filed and served, the Defendant’s solicitor makes a Part 36 offer of £125,000 (‘the Offer’) on behalf of her client. The relevant period for acceptance of the Offer is 21 days.

One week after expiry of the relevant period the Defendant’s solicitor meets in conference with Counsel to discuss the case. Two weeks after the expiry of the relevant period the Defendant’s solicitor receives a letter from the Claimant stating that she no longer has solicitors acting on her behalf. Her letter also includes notice of acceptance of the Offer with confirmation that her notice of acceptance has also been filed with the court.
stemZh: 原告因财务顾问的过失建议索赔超过£100,000。被告提交并送达答辩当日提出£125,000的Part 36要约，相关期间21日。期间届满一周后，被告律师与大律师会商；届满两周后，原告通知不再聘请律师，并向被告律师及法院提交接受通知。
ask: Which of the following statements describes the most likely costs consequences in the case?
askZh: 最可能的费用后果是什么？

options.en: The Claimant will pay the Defendant’s costs of the case on the standard basis.
options.zh: 原告按standard basis承担被告全案费用。

options.en: The Claimant will pay the Defendant’s costs of the case on the indemnity basis.
options.zh: 原告按indemnity basis承担被告全案费用。

options.en: The Defendant will pay the Claimant’s costs on the standard basis to the expiry of the relevant period, and thereafter the Claimant will pay the Defendant’s costs on the standard basis.
options.zh: 被告按standard basis承担期间届满前原告费用；其后原告按standard basis承担被告费用。

options.en: The Defendant will pay the Claimant’s costs of the case on the standard basis.
options.zh: 被告按standard basis承担原告全案费用。

options.en: The Defendant will pay the Claimant’s costs on the indemnity basis to the expiry of the relevant period, and thereafter the Claimant will pay the Defendant’s costs on the indemnity basis.
options.zh: 届满前被告、届满后原告分别按indemnity basis承担对方费用。

explanation.topic: Part 36 late acceptance · 逾期接受费用
explanation.zh: 选C。接受仍可有效，但原告迟于相关期间接受被告要约，通常按时间划分费用：截止期间届满的原告费用由被告承担；其后至接受前被告费用由原告承担，通常按standard basis，除非法院认为不公。
explanation.ruleZh: 被告Part 36要约逾期接受：通常以relevant period届满划分费用。
explanation.warning: 停止聘请律师本身不会使迟延接受自动免责，也不把会商费用自动移出分段范围。

A.zh: 不能把原告接受期限前的费用安排全部倒置。

B.zh: 既错在覆盖全案，又无自动indemnity依据。

C.zh: 正确按relevant period届满时点分段。

D.zh: 忽略原告迟延接受带来的后段费用后果。

E.zh: 迟延接受不自动将双方费用改为indemnity basis。

points.zh: 被告Part 36要约逾期接受：通常以relevant period届满划分费用。

stem:
A self-employed builder who wishes to buy goods from a building supplies company contacts a solicitor for advice about the one page written contract that the company has sent to him. The reverse of the contract states the company’s standard written terms of business. The builder has been asked to sign, date and return the contract to the company if he wishes to use the company to supply goods. The builder has received no other communication from the company.

The solicitor reads the contract, including the terms shown on the reverse. He correctly states the terms have been incorporated but identifies that one of the standard written terms of business seeks to exclude a type of liability which cannot be excluded under any circumstances.
stemZh: 个体建筑商收到供货公司一页合同，背面为标准条款，如愿采购须签名、日期并返回。他没有收到其他沟通。律师已正确认定条款订入合同，但发现一项排除的责任绝不允许排除。
ask: Which of the following terms is the solicitor referring to?
askZh: 该条款是哪一项？

options.en: Exclusion of liability for misrepresentation made by the company before the contract was entered into.
options.zh: 排除公司订约前虚假陈述责任。

options.en: Exclusion of liability for breach of the statutory implied term that the goods will be fit for a particular purpose.
options.zh: 排除货物适合特定用途的默示条款责任。

options.en: Exclusion of liability for breach of the statutory implied term that the seller has title to the goods at the time of sale.
options.zh: 排除卖方出售时享有货物所有权的默示条款责任。

options.en: Exclusion of liability for breach of the statutory implied term that the goods supplied will be of satisfactory quality.
options.zh: 排除满意质量的默示条款责任。

options.en: Exclusion of liability for breach of the statutory implied term that the goods sold by description will correspond with that description.
options.zh: 排除凭描述出售时符合描述的默示条款责任。

explanation.topic: Title exclusion · 所有权义务免责
explanation.zh: 选 C。五个选项都在问卖方能否事先约定“不承担某种责任”。其中，卖方有权出售货物是最基本的义务，法律不允许用本题的免责条款排除。相比之下，企业间交易中对质量、用途或描述责任的免责，通常仍有通过合理性审查的可能，所以不能说这些责任在任何情况下都不允许排除。
explanation.ruleZh: B2B：title 不可排除；quality / fitness / description 通常查reasonableness。

A.zh: 非欺诈等相应虚假陈述免责可能受合理性控制，不是该选项所述一切情形均禁止。

B.zh: 在本题B2B路径中通常可进入合理性审查。

C.zh: 卖方出售权利的法定默示义务不能以这种条款排除。

D.zh: B2B满意质量免责通常需通过合理性审查。

E.zh: B2B描述义务免责通常需通过合理性审查。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 跳过已解决的订入问题
reasoningSteps.detail: 题目明确律师已正确认定条款订入。现需比较各条免责在法律上的效力。

reasoningSteps.title: 区分不得排除与合理性审查
reasoningSteps.detail: B2B买卖中，SGA第12条卖方出售权利的默示义务不得以本题条款排除；描述、质量、用途等条款则通常查UCTA合理性。

reasoningSteps.title: 选择最绝对的一项
reasoningSteps.detail: 只有C抓住这里不可排除的title义务。不要把所有法定默示条款都当成同一类。

textbookReferences.section: SGA第12条出售权；B2B中第13–15条责任及合理性
卖方出售权利；描述、质量及特定用途义务

points.zh: 卖方首先必须有权出售货物。这项基本义务不能靠合同中的免责条款排除，例如卖方不能写“即使我无权卖这批货，也不负责”来逃避责任。
本题是企业间买卖。货物质量、用途及描述等义务的免责，通常要进一步审查是否合理，与出售权利义务不可排除的规则不同。

stem:
A motorist negligently causes a collision with another car which is driven by a woman. As a result of the negligent collision, the woman suffers several losses.

She suffers serious hand and arm injuries which will require extensive physiotherapy. The woman intends to pay for private physiotherapy as the waiting list on the National Health Service is many months long. Her car is badly damaged and requires substantial repairs. Her laptop is on the passenger seat of the car and is damaged beyond repair. The woman uses the laptop for business purposes. The woman’s antique engagement ring worth £10,000 is destroyed in the accident as the diamonds in it shatter in the force of the collision.

The woman brings a claim in negligence for all these losses. The motorist accepts liability for the collision but disputes quantum.
stemZh: 驾驶人过失撞上女性驾驶的车。女性手臂重伤，拟因NHS候诊过长而自费接受理疗；车辆严重损坏；副驾驶座上的商务笔记本电脑报废；价值£10,000的古董订婚戒指因撞击钻石破碎而毁损。驾驶人承认事故责任，但争议赔偿金额。
ask: In addition to liability for the personal injury and the damage to the car, what other losses is the motorist liable for?
askZh: 除人身伤害和车辆损坏外，还须赔哪些损失？

options.en: The woman’s private physiotherapy treatment, her laptop and antique ring.
options.zh: 自费理疗、笔记本电脑和古董戒指。

options.en: The woman’s private physiotherapy treatment only.
options.zh: 仅自费理疗。

options.en: The woman’s antique ring and laptop only.
options.zh: 仅戒指和电脑。

options.en: The woman’s laptop only.
options.zh: 仅电脑。

options.en: The woman’s antique ring and private physiotherapy treatment only.
options.zh: 仅戒指和自费理疗。

explanation.topic: Consequential losses · 治疗及财产损失
explanation.zh: 选A。合理的私人理疗费用及事故造成的电脑、戒指实体损害均可赔偿。需要可合理预见的是损害种类，不要求预先知道该戒指的特殊高价；电脑用于营业也不把其实体毁损变成纯经济损失。
explanation.ruleZh: 区分实体财产损害与pure economic loss；可预见种类不等于可预见精确金额。
explanation.warning: 有NHS服务不当然要求受害人放弃合理私人治疗，但具体费用仍需合理。

A.zh: 三项均有相应可赔基础，金额仍须合理证明。

B.zh: 错误排除事故直接造成的物品损坏。

C.zh: 错误排除合理私人治疗费用。

D.zh: 遗漏治疗费和戒指实体损害。

E.zh: 遗漏电脑实体损害，商务用途不构成排除理由。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 区分实体财产损害与pure economic loss；可预见种类不等于可预见精确金额。

warning.zh: 有NHS服务不当然要求受害人放弃合理私人治疗，但具体费用仍需合理。

stem:
A woman works for a local charity for disabled people. The main function of the charity is to arrange transport for disabled people in and around the community. The charity uses one particular firm of taxi drivers to carry out this function.

The woman reads in a newspaper about recent legislation which requires taxi drivers to help disabled people when using their taxis. The woman looks up the legislation and finds as follows:

Taxis and Private Hire Vehicles (Disabled Persons) Act 2022 2022 CHAPTER 29 An Act to make provision relating to the carrying of disabled persons by taxis and private hire vehicles. [28th April 2022]

The woman wants to know what is the significance of the date 28th April 2022 and telephones the charity’s solicitor for legal advice.
stemZh: 残障人士慈善机构员工看到《Taxis and Private Hire Vehicles (Disabled Persons) Act 2022》：标题标注2022 CHAPTER 29，长标题后方括号内写“28th April 2022”。她向律师询问该日期含义。
ask: What should the solicitor advise?
askZh: 应如何解释该日期？

options.en: It is the date the most recent draft of the statute was presented to the House of Commons.
options.zh: 最新草案提交下议院的日期。

options.en: It is the provisional date set for the statute coming into force.
options.zh: 预计施行日期。

options.en: It is the date the statute received Royal Assent.
options.zh: 获得Royal Assent的日期。

options.en: It is the commencement date of the statute.
options.zh: 法律开始施行的日期。

options.en: It is the date on which the statute passed its Committee Stage in the House of Commons.
options.zh: 下议院委员会阶段通过日期。

explanation.topic: Royal Assent · 御准日期
explanation.zh: 选C。成文法长标题后方括号中的日期表示取得 **Royal Assent**。法律何时实际生效，须另看施行条款及相关命令，不必然等于御准日期。
explanation.ruleZh: Royal Assent 与 commencement 分开识别。
explanation.warning: 不要因法案已获御准，就假定所有条文当天全部生效。

A.zh: 不是草案递交日期。

B.zh: 不是暂定生效时间。

C.zh: 该位置标示御准日期。

D.zh: 施行日期需另查，可能与御准日期不同。

E.zh: 不是委员会阶段的时间。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Royal Assent 与 commencement 分开识别。

warning.zh: 不要因法案已获御准，就假定所有条文当天全部生效。

stem:
A paralegal is employed by a firm of solicitors, which is authorised as a legal services body.

The paralegal has not worked in a solicitors’ firm before and has no other relevant work experience. She works in the civil litigation debt recovery department and her work is directly supervised by a practising solicitor in the department.
stemZh: 律师助理第一次在律所工作，没有其他相关经验。律所是获授权的legal services body；她在民事债务追收部门工作，由执业律师直接监督。
ask: Will the paralegal be subject to regulation by an approved legal regulator?
askZh: 她是否受认可法律监管机构监管？

options.en: Yes, by the Solicitors Regulation Authority.
options.zh: 受SRA监管。

options.en: Yes, by the Legal Services Board.
options.zh: 受Legal Services Board监管。

options.en: Yes, by the Law Society.
options.zh: 受Law Society监管。

options.en: No, as a paralegal, she is not subject to regulation.
options.zh: 不受监管，因为她是paralegal。

options.en: No, as she is directly supervised by a practising solicitor.
options.zh: 不受监管，因为她由执业律师直接监督。

explanation.topic: SRA regulation · 律所非律师员工
explanation.zh: 选A。受SRA监管机构内工作的非律师员工也可能处于SRA监管及执法权限范围，不会因为是paralegal或有人监督而完全脱离监管。
explanation.ruleZh: 律所员工并非都必须是solicitor，但不等于不受监管。
explanation.warning: 受监管不意味着该助理已经取得律师资格或可独立从事全部保留法律业务。

A.zh: SRA负责相关律所及其人员的监管。

B.zh: LSB监督批准监管机构，并非本题日常直接监管者。

C.zh: Law Society的代表职能与SRA的监管职能不同。

D.zh: paralegal职位不产生普遍监管豁免。

E.zh: 监督是管理要求，不是免受监管的理由。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 律所员工并非都必须是solicitor，但不等于不受监管。

warning.zh: 受监管不意味着该助理已经取得律师资格或可独立从事全部保留法律业务。

stem: A new firm of solicitors is voluntarily registered for Value Added Tax (VAT) and makes only standard-rated supplies. During the relevant VAT period it charges output tax of £10,000 on its services and it pays input tax of £20,000 on goods it buys for the purposes of its business and on its heating bills.
stemZh: 新律所自愿登记VAT，只提供标准税率服务。本期服务销项税£10,000，购买营业用货物及支付取暖账单产生进项税£20,000。
ask: Which of the following statements best describes the firm’s position at the end of the relevant VAT period?
askZh: 期末VAT情况是什么？

options.en: The firm does not have to pay any VAT and cannot reclaim any VAT.
options.zh: 不用缴税，也不能退税。

options.en: The firm can reclaim £10,000 VAT.
The firm can reclaim £20,000 VAT.
The firm must pay £10,000 VAT.
The firm must pay £20,000 VAT.

explanation.topic: VAT repayment · 增值税退税
explanation.zh: 选B。题设业务均为标准税率供应，相应可抵扣进项税与销项税抵销：£10,000−£20,000＝−£10,000，形成£10,000可退余额。自愿登记不意味着无抵扣权。
explanation.ruleZh: VAT net＝output tax−deductible input tax。
explanation.warning: 只因是新所或自愿登记，不会使正常可抵扣进项税失效。

A.zh: 进项超过销项会产生可退余额，而非直接归零。

C.zh: 忽略应抵销的£10,000销项税。

D.zh: 将应退余额方向颠倒。

E.zh: 将进项税误当成应另行缴纳税款。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: VAT net＝output tax−deductible input tax。

warning.zh: 只因是新所或自愿登记，不会使正常可抵扣进项税失效。

stem:
A solicitor employed by a firm is acting for a client in the purchase of a new build residential property for £350,000. Contracts were exchanged a few months ago, the building works have finished and the completion date is set for next week.

Six weeks ago, a suspicious activity report (SAR) was correctly submitted online to the appropriate authority by the firm’s nominated officer as a result of information obtained by the solicitor that the client is concerned in money laundering. The SAR included a request for permission to proceed with completion of the purchase of the property.

A refusal of consent to complete the purchase was received five weeks ago. There has been no further communication from the appropriate authority or any application by them to the court since. No action has been taken against the client or his assets, and the client has not been informed that he is under investigation for money laundering.
stemZh: 律师为客户购买£350,000新建住宅，几个月前已交换合同，下周交割。六周前指定负责人因客户涉及洗钱，正确提交SAR并请求许可继续交易。五周前收到拒绝，此后没有进一步通知或申请法院延长期限，也未对客户及资产采取行动，客户不知道调查。
ask: Will the nominated officer commit an offence under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 if he gives consent to the solicitor to proceed with the purchase next week?
askZh: 指定负责人下周允许律师交割，是否违反POCA 2002？

options.en: Yes, because a refusal to consent has been received.
options.zh: 会，因为已收到拒绝。

options.en: Yes, because the refusal to consent has not been reversed within the following 31 days.
options.zh: 会，因为拒绝后31日内未被撤回。

options.en: No, because it has been more than 31 days since the submission of the SAR.
options.zh: 不会，因为提交SAR已超过31日。

options.en: No, because the client has not been informed that he is being investigated for money laundering and no action has been taken against the client or his assets.
options.zh: 不会，因为客户不知被调查且未被采取行动。

options.en: No, because it has been more than 31 days since the refusal to consent was received.
options.zh: 不会，因为收到拒绝已超过31日。

explanation.topic: DAML moratorium · 拒绝后的等待期
explanation.zh: 选E。相关31日 **moratorium period** 从收到拒绝的法定时点计算，不是从提交SAR计算。拒绝已过去五周且无延长申请，本题在其届满后继续交易有相应法定保护。
explanation.ruleZh: 拒绝后31日；另查法院是否依法延长。
explanation.warning: 不要把notice period与moratorium period混淆，也不要认为任何SAR提交31日后都能操作。

A.zh: 拒绝不在本题无延长情形下永久阻止继续交易。

B.zh: 无需一定收到撤回拒绝通知，关键是法定期间是否届满。

C.zh: 起算点错误，提交报告日与拒绝日不同。

D.zh: 客户是否知情及是否被采取行动，不是本题允许继续的法定理由。

E.zh: 正确使用收到拒绝后的31日期间，且题干排除了延长。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 拒绝后31日；另查法院是否依法延长。

warning.zh: 不要把notice period与moratorium period混淆，也不要认为任何SAR提交31日后都能操作。

stem:
A woman is given a new electronic tablet (‘the Tablet’) as a birthday present from her friend. The friend bought it from a local retailer (‘the Retailer’). The Retailer was unaware that the friend was buying it as a present for the woman.

When the woman tries to use the Tablet, she is unable to switch it on as there is a fault with the power button. The woman does not want to tell her friend that the Tablet does not work because it is a birthday present and so takes the Tablet to a local repair shop.

The shop repairs the fault in the Tablet for a charge of £150, which the woman pays. The woman wishes to sue the Retailer in negligence to recover the £150.
stemZh: 女性生日收到朋友赠送的新平板，朋友从零售商购入，零售商不知道是送她的礼物。平板电源键有缺陷无法开机。她不愿告诉朋友，另找维修店修好并支付£150，现想以过失起诉零售商追回维修费。
ask: Can the woman recover the £150 repair costs in negligence from the Retailer?
askZh: 能否以negligence向零售商追回£150？

options.en: No, because the defect in the Tablet is unforeseeable loss.
options.zh: 不能，因为缺陷属于不可预见损失。

options.en: Yes, because the Tablet was faulty.
options.zh: 可以，因为平板有缺陷。

options.en: Yes, because the repair costs are consequential economic loss.
options.zh: 可以，因为费用属后续经济损失。

options.en: No, because the repair costs are pure economic loss.
options.zh: 不能，因为费用属纯经济损失。

options.en: Yes, because the Retailer is strictly liable for the repair costs.
options.zh: 可以，因为零售商对维修费负严格责任。

explanation.topic: Defective product itself · 产品自身缺陷
explanation.zh: 选D。仅修复有缺陷产品本身的支出，属于 **pure economic loss**；没有人身伤害或其他财产损坏，也无题设支持的特殊注意义务，不能依普通过失规则向零售商追偿。
explanation.ruleZh: 修复缺陷产品本身通常是pure economic loss。
explanation.warning: 不要把有缺陷产品自身维修费与它引起的其他财产损坏混淆；合同救济需另查当事人身份。

A.zh: 关键不是不可预见，而是产品自身缺陷的纯经济损失限制。

B.zh: 存在缺陷并不自动建立侵权赔偿请求。

C.zh: 这里没有独立的人身或其他财产损害供经济损失附随。

D.zh: 正确归类为修复缺陷产品本身的纯经济损失。

E.zh: 普通negligence请求不以严格责任处理。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 修复缺陷产品本身通常是pure economic loss。

warning.zh: 不要把有缺陷产品自身维修费与它引起的其他财产损坏混淆；合同救济需另查当事人身份。

stem:
A private limited company (‘the Seller’) entered into a contract with another private limited company (‘the Buyer’) for the sale of 8,000 Christmas trees at a price of £160,000. The contract provided for interest at 7% per annum to be paid on all overdue payments.

The Seller delivered the trees in accordance with the contract, but the Buyer has not paid the price. The Seller has complied with the necessary pre-action requirements and now wishes to issue proceedings against the Buyer for the outstanding sum due, and interest on that sum. The Seller’s solicitor is drafting the claim form.
stemZh: 卖方公司向买方公司出售8,000棵圣诞树，总价£160,000，约定逾期付款按年利率7%付息。卖方已如约交货，买方未付款。卖方完成诉前要求，律师现起草请求本金和利息的claim form。
ask: Which claim for interest should be included in the claim form?
askZh: 应列入何种利息请求？

options.en: Interest at 8% per annum under section 35A of the Senior Courts Act 1981 or section 69 of the County Courts Act 1984.
options.zh: 依1981年法第35A条或1984年法第69条请求年息8%。

options.en: Interest at 7% per annum under the contract.
options.zh: 依合同请求年息7%。

options.en: Interest at 8% per annum over the Bank of England base rate under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.
options.zh: 依1998年商业债务迟付法请求英格兰银行基准利率加8%。

options.en: Interest at 10% per annum under section 35A of the Senior Courts Act 1981 or section 69 of the County Courts Act 1984.
options.zh: 依1981年法或1984年法请求年息10%。

options.en: Interest at 1% per annum over the Bank of England base rate under either section 35A of the Senior Courts Act 1981 or section 69 of the County Courts Act 1984.
options.zh: 依1981年法或1984年法请求基准利率加1%。

explanation.topic: Contractual interest · 合同利息
explanation.zh: 选B。本题已有明确逾期付款利息条款，按合同年息7%主张，不能只因另有法定利息制度就直接改用较高利率。
explanation.ruleZh: 先找合同利息条款，再识别是否有适用的法定替代。
explanation.warning: 商业迟付法对合同补救是否实质充分另有规则；本题没有要求推翻7%条款的事实。

A.zh: 忽略本题明确约定，且法定酌定利息不当然固定为8%。

B.zh: 正确落实逾期付款合同条款。

C.zh: 本题按约定利息请求，不能不经审查就替换成商业迟付法利率。

D.zh: 没有本题所需的10%依据。

E.zh: 所列基准加1%不是题干合同或该项法定依据。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 先找合同利息条款，再识别是否有适用的法定替代。

warning.zh: 商业迟付法对合同补救是否实质充分另有规则；本题没有要求推翻7%条款的事实。

stem:
A solicitor is representing a client at an arbitration hearing which will include the examination of witnesses. A legal representative (‘the Representative’) acts for the opposing party in the arbitration.

The client sees the Representative speaking to a witness for the opposing party outside the hearing room. The client overhears the Representative telling the witness what questions to expect during her cross-examination and the answers she should give to those questions.

The client mentions this to the solicitor and instructs the solicitor to have similar conversations with witnesses giving evidence on the client’s behalf.
stemZh: 律师参加将询问证人的仲裁。客户看到对方代理人在庭外告诉对方证人交叉询问可能问什么，以及应该怎样回答，便要求自己的律师对己方证人也这样做。
ask: Which of the following is relevant to whether the solicitor is permitted to have such conversations?
askZh: 判断律师能否进行这类谈话，什么因素相关？

options.en: The opposing party in the arbitration is engaging in such conduct.
options.zh: 对方也在这样做。

options.en: Such conversations will be subject to legal privilege.
options.zh: 谈话受法律职业保密特权保护。

options.en: Conducting an arbitration is not a reserved legal activity.
options.zh: 仲裁代理不是保留法律业务。

options.en: Such conversations may influence the substance of the witnesses’ evidence.
options.zh: 谈话可能影响证人证言的实质内容。

options.en: The solicitor has been instructed by the client to have such conversations.
options.zh: 客户已明确要求进行谈话。

explanation.topic: Witness evidence · 证言实质与辅导边界
explanation.zh: 选D。律师不得不当影响证据实质，告诉证人应该提供哪些实质答案可能越过正当准备与熟悉程序的边界。对方做法或客户指示不能使不当行为正当化。
explanation.ruleZh: 可以熟悉程序；不得不当塑造证言实质。
explanation.warning: 不要把任何与证人沟通都视为禁止；关键在沟通内容与对证据的影响。

A.zh: 对方违规不授权己方照做。

B.zh: 保密特权不为不当影响证言提供许可。

C.zh: 是否保留业务不免除律师职业义务。

D.zh: 直接触及不得影响证据实质的要求。

E.zh: 客户指示不能凌驾职业规范。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 可以熟悉程序；不得不当塑造证言实质。

warning.zh: 不要把任何与证人沟通都视为禁止；关键在沟通内容与对证据的影响。

stem:
A private limited company is in insolvent liquidation. The liquidator has sold the company’s property and is distributing the proceeds to those entitled. The value of the company’s net property for the purposes of the Insolvency Act 1986 (‘the Net Property’) is £100,000. The liquidator has not yet made any distributions to the following creditors:

● the company’s bank, which is owed £110,000 and which holds a valid floating charge created six years ago over all the company’s property ● numerous unsecured creditors who together are owed a total of £50,000

The company only has ordinary shares in issue. The company’s three shareholders each paid £5,000 for their ordinary shares (£15,000 in total).
stemZh: 公司进入资不抵债清算。为Insolvency Act 1986目的计算的net property为£100,000。银行债权£110,000，有六年前设立、覆盖全部资产的有效浮动抵押；其他无担保债权合计£50,000，均未获分配。公司仅有普通股，三名股东各出资£5,000。
ask: How should the liquidator distribute the Net Property?
askZh: 应如何分配net property？

options.en: The liquidator should ring-fence a prescribed part of the Net Property for distribution to the bank and distribute the balance to the unsecured creditors.
options.zh: 先为银行划出prescribed part，余额给无担保债权人。

options.en: The liquidator should distribute all of the Net Property to the bank, because it is valued at under £800,000.
options.zh: 资产少于£800,000，全部给银行。

options.en: The liquidator should ring-fence a prescribed part of the Net Property for distribution to the unsecured creditors and distribute the balance to the bank.
options.zh: 先为无担保债权人划出prescribed part，余额给银行。

options.en: The liquidator should distribute all of the Net Property to the bank, because the floating charge holder is not an associate of the company.
options.zh: 银行非关联方，全部给银行。

options.en: The liquidator should ring-fence a prescribed part of the Net Property for distribution to the shareholders and distribute the balance to the bank.
options.zh: 先为股东划出prescribed part，余额给银行。

explanation.topic: Prescribed part · 浮动抵押资产预留
explanation.zh: 选C。**Prescribed part** 从相应浮动抵押资产净额中为无担保债权人保留；其余在本题分给浮动抵押银行。股东不优先于尚未受偿债权人。
explanation.ruleZh: Prescribed part 给unsecured creditors；剩余处理浮动抵押债权。
explanation.warning: 浮动抵押优先并非意味着拿走全部资产；不要把预留上限当作触发起点。

A.zh: 把预留的受益人与剩余分配对象颠倒。

B.zh: 上限不是免预留门槛，净额低于该数不意味着全归银行。

C.zh: 正确区分无担保债权人的预留部分及银行余额。

D.zh: 银行是否关联方不取消本题预留要求。

E.zh: prescribed part保护无担保债权人，不是股东。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Prescribed part 给unsecured creditors；剩余处理浮动抵押债权。

warning.zh: 浮动抵押优先并非意味着拿走全部资产；不要把预留上限当作触发起点。

stem: A footballer aged 17 enters into a long-term contract with an agent to negotiate commercial contracts on his behalf as a professional football player. The footballer’s parents are not co- signatories to the contract. A month later, when the footballer is still 17, the footballer decides that he no longer wants the agent to represent him and that he wants to bring the contract to an end.
stemZh: 17岁职业球员与经纪人订立长期合同，由经纪人代其谈判商业合同，父母没有共同签署。一个月后他仍未满18岁，决定不再接受该经纪人代理并终止合同。
ask: Can the footballer terminate the contract?
askZh: 球员能否终止合同？

options.en: No, because he is of full capacity being over 16 years of age.
options.zh: 不能，超过16岁已具有完全行为能力。

options.en: No, because it is a commercial contract and not a consumer contract.
options.zh: 不能，这是商业而非消费者合同。

options.en: No, because he is a minor and it is a contract for necessaries.
options.zh: 不能，他是未成年人且合同属于necessaries。

options.en: Yes, because he is a minor and it is not a contract for necessaries.
options.zh: 可以，他未成年，且该合同不属于necessaries。

options.en: Yes, because his parents were not co-signatories to the contract.
options.zh: 可以，因为父母没有共同签署。

explanation.topic: Minor’s contract · 未成年人经纪合同
explanation.zh: 选 D。球员只有17岁，仍属于minor。本题合同是让经纪人长期替他谈商业交易，并不是向他供应necessaries，也不是其本人接受雇佣、教育或培训的合同。因此，按题设他可以结束该经纪安排。父母没有共同签字，并不是答案成立的原因。
explanation.ruleZh: 先看年龄，再识别necessaries或有益服务等特定类别。
explanation.warning: 未成年人并非对所有合同都不受约束。供应必需品，以及整体上有利于他的雇佣、教育或培训合同，有不同规则。

A.zh: 一般成年门槛是18岁，不是16岁。

B.zh: 商业标签不排除未成年人能力规则。

C.zh: 经纪人代谈商业合同不属于本题的necessaries。

D.zh: 符合本题未成年人及合同性质的判断。

E.zh: 父母未共同签署不是本题解除权的法律根本原因。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 检查年龄
reasoningSteps.detail: 17岁属于minor；成年界限不是16岁。

reasoningSteps.title: 检查例外合同
reasoningSteps.detail: 代理人长期代表其谈商业合同，不是本题可强制约束未成年人的necessaries合同，也不能仅因关联职业就当成其雇佣或培训合同。

reasoningSteps.title: 结论及排除干扰
reasoningSteps.detail: 本题可以终止，选D。父母未共同签署不是独立的普遍无效规则。

textbookReferences.section: Contracts with minors；例3.3
未成年人；必需品与有益服务合同

textbookExample.title: 教材例3.3：已有衣物的未成年买家
textbookExample.facts: 未成年人已有足够合适衣物，仍购买多件华丽背心。教材以Nash v Inman说明这些商品不属其当时所需必需品。
textbookExample.lesson: Necessaries关注性质、生活状况及订约时实际需要，不是只看“可能有帮助”。
textbookExample.connection: 本题长期商业经纪服务不能仅因有助于赚钱就自动成为necessaries。

points.zh: 17岁仍是未成年人。判断其是否受合同约束，还要看合同属于什么类型；不能因为他已经能踢职业足球，就当成成年人处理。
必需品须符合该未成年人的生活状况和实际需要。本题是长期商业经纪安排，不因有助于职业发展就自动属于必需品，也不是让他接受雇佣或培训的合同。

warning.zh: 未成年人并非对所有合同都不受约束。供应必需品，以及整体上有利于他的雇佣、教育或培训合同，有不同规则。

stem:
The law on Land Transaction Tax in Wales is under review with proposals being made to increase the tax to be paid for properties used as holiday homes.

A woman registered to vote and living in Wales, but who is English, wishes to express her opposition to the proposed changes. She intends to write to her elected representative who sits on the body which has power to vote on this matter.

She would like to know whether she should write to her Member of Parliament at Westminster (‘MP’) or to her Member of Senedd Cymru (‘MS’).
stemZh: 威尔士拟提高度假住宅的Land Transaction Tax。居住威尔士且在当地登记投票的英格兰女性，希望向有权表决此事的机构中的民选代表表示反对，咨询应写给Westminster的MP还是Senedd Cymru的MS。
ask: Which elected representative(s) should the woman write to?
askZh: 应写给谁？

options.en: To her MP because it concerns a reserved matter of the UK Parliament.
options.zh: MP，因为是英国议会保留事项。

options.en: To her MS because it concerns a devolved power of Senedd Cymru.
options.zh: MS，因为是Senedd Cymru的下放权限。

options.en: To her MP because it concerns a conferred power of the UK Parliament.
options.zh: MP，因为是英国议会被授予权限。

options.en: To both her MP and her MS because it concerns a joint power of the UK Parliament and Senedd Cymru.
options.zh: MP及MS，因为是两者共同行使权限。

options.en: To her MS because it concerns a reserved power of Senedd Cymru.
options.zh: MS，因为是Senedd Cymru的保留权限。

explanation.topic: Devolution · 威尔士土地交易税
explanation.zh: 选B。威尔士土地交易税属于下放税权，拟议变化对应Senedd Cymru的职权，应联系其MS。她自认英格兰人不改变题设居住及代表关系。
explanation.ruleZh: Welsh LTT → devolved power → Senedd / MS。
explanation.warning: SQE最佳答案要同时核对人选和理由，不能只见MS就选。

A.zh: 将下放税权误列为Westminster保留事项。

B.zh: 正确对应威尔士下放税收权限。

C.zh: 错误识别立法机构。

D.zh: 题干没有所谓需两机构共同投票的权限安排。

E.zh: 代表选对，但把devolved说成reserved，理由错误。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Welsh LTT → devolved power → Senedd / MS。

warning.zh: SQE最佳答案要同时核对人选和理由，不能只见MS就选。

stem:
A man is arrested and detained at a police station on suspicion of common assault which is a summary only offence. The man is homeless and has no income.

The man is not legally represented during his interview under caution, in which he denies the offence. After the interview the man is told that he will be charged with the offence. The man states that he now wants legal advice as he does not want the police to charge him.
stemZh: 男性因涉嫌common assault这一仅简易审理罪被捕并羁押在警署。他无固定住处、无收入。警诫讯问中没有律师，否认犯罪；讯问结束后警方称将起诉，他此时要求法律建议。
ask: Is the man entitled to publicly funded legal advice at the police station?
askZh: 他是否有权取得警署公费法律帮助？

options.en: No, because the offence for which he has been arrested is a summary only offence.
options.zh: 没有，因为只涉及summary-only offence。

options.en: Yes, because he has no address in England and Wales.
options.zh: 有，因为没有英格兰与威尔士地址。

options.en: Yes, because he has been arrested and is in custody at a police station.
options.zh: 有，因为被捕并羁押在警署。

options.en: Yes, because he satisfies the means test.
options.zh: 有，因为通过经济状况审查。

options.en: No, because the interview under caution has already taken place.
options.zh: 没有，因为警诫讯问已经结束。

explanation.topic: Police station advice · 警署法律帮助
explanation.zh: 选C。被捕并在警署羁押者可获得相应免费独立法律建议，不以通过普通经济状况审查为前提，也不因已经接受一次讯问而失去权利。
explanation.ruleZh: 警署羁押法律建议：不以means test为前提。
explanation.warning: 区分警署法律帮助与后续法院程序的法律援助资格。

A.zh: 简易罪性质不取消该项权利。

B.zh: 无住址不是法律基础。

C.zh: 正确识别警署羁押者的法律帮助权。

D.zh: 结论虽为有权，但不是因为通过means test。

E.zh: 讯问后仍可请求法律建议。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 警署羁押法律建议：不以means test为前提。

warning.zh: 区分警署法律帮助与后续法院程序的法律援助资格。

stem:
For the last 24 years a man has run a business from premises on the outskirts of a village. The man obtained planning permission for this business use when he started his business. The only house in the immediate vicinity of the man’s business has been owned and occupied by a woman for the last 22 years.

The noise from the man’s business has always been considerable but the woman did not complain because her father was great friends with the man. The woman’s father died three months ago and she has now brought an action in private nuisance against the man. It is accepted that the noise levels, which have not changed since the business started, constitute an actionable nuisance unless the man can raise a successful defence.
stemZh: 男性已在村郊经营24年，开业时取得规划许可。附近唯一房屋由女性居住并拥有22年。业务噪音始终很大，但女性父亲与其关系好，她此前未抱怨。父亲三个月前去世后，她起诉private nuisance。双方承认噪音一直未变，除非有抗辩，否则属于可诉妨害。
ask: Can the man successfully use the defence of prescription?
askZh: 能否成功援引prescription抗辩？

options.en: No, because the claim only became actionable when the woman complained about the noise.
options.zh: 不能，只有投诉后才成为可诉妨害。

options.en: Yes, because the man has run his business for more than 20 years without complaint.
options.zh: 能，因为超过20年持续经营且无人投诉。

options.en: No, because the defence does not apply to private nuisance.
options.zh: 不能，该抗辩不适用于private nuisance。

options.en: Yes, because the man has obtained planning permission.
options.zh: 能，因为有规划许可。

options.en: No, because the woman came to the nuisance after the man had begun running his business.
options.zh: 不能，因为她在业务开始后才搬来。

explanation.topic: Prescription · 私人妨害时效取得
explanation.zh: 选B。按题干，噪音对该房屋已构成持续、可诉妨害超过20年，且无有效中断或许可安排事实，支持prescription。关键是可诉妨害持续的时间，不只是企业开业多久。
explanation.ruleZh: 20年须是对有关土地构成可诉妨害的期间。
explanation.warning: 不要只背“企业营业20年”；若损害后来才达到可诉程度，起算会不同。

A.zh: 是否可诉不以实际先投诉为必要条件。

B.zh: 结合题干22年的持续可诉妨害，满足本题20年要求。

C.zh: Prescription可以是私人妨害抗辩。

D.zh: 规划许可本身并非制造私人妨害的普遍免责。

E.zh: “搬到妨害旁边”通常不是阻却其请求的独立理由，也不否定已成立的prescription。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 20年须是对有关土地构成可诉妨害的期间。

warning.zh: 不要只背“企业营业20年”；若损害后来才达到可诉程度，起算会不同。

stem:
A solicitor is acting on behalf of a claimant in her claim against a local firm of accountants (‘the Defendant’). The claimant’s claim is that she acted on negligent advice provided by the Defendant. All appropriate pre-action procedures have been followed and proceedings have been issued and served.

The solicitor receives an email from the firm of solicitors acting for the Defendant which explains that the solicitor who had conduct of the matter has been absent from the office due to ill health. The firm has filed the acknowledgment of service with the court on behalf of the Defendant but requires an extension of time in order to prepare and file their client’s defence.

The claimant’s solicitor agrees to an extension of seven days for the filing of the defence and the court is notified in writing.

On the date that the agreed seven day extension period is due to expire, the Defendant’s solicitor requests a further extension to the time for filing the defence.
stemZh: 原告因会计师事务所过失建议起诉，诉前程序完成且诉状已送达。被告律师因负责人员生病，在已提交acknowledgment of service后请求延长答辩期。原告律师同意延长7日并书面通知法院。该7日即将届满时，被告又请求延期。
ask: What is the maximum further extension, if any, to which the claimant’s solicitor can agree without the permission of the court?
askZh: 无需法院许可，还能同意延长最多多久？

options.en: A further seven day extension.
options.zh: 再延长7日。

options.en: A further 14 day extension.
options.zh: 再延长14日。

options.en: A further 21 day extension.
options.zh: 再延长21日。

options.en: A further 28 day extension.
options.zh: 再延长28日。

options.en: No further extension is permitted.
options.zh: 不能再延期。

explanation.topic: Defence extension · 协议延长答辩期
explanation.zh: 选C。CPR 15.5允许双方将相关答辩期限协议延长合计不超过28日。已使用7日，剩余21日；不是每次协议都重新取得28日。
explanation.ruleZh: CPR 15.5：协议延期合计最多28日；已用期间扣除。
explanation.warning: 这28日是对适用答辩期限的延长，不是把acknowledgment后的原本答辩期限也全部混在一起。

A.zh: 并非剩余上限。

B.zh: 仍低于剩余可协议上限。

D.zh: 错误把总额度当成新一轮额度。

E.zh: 尚有总上限内21日可协议延长。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: CPR 15.5：协议延期合计最多28日；已用期间扣除。
