stem: A private limited company has unamended model articles as set out in Schedule 1 to the Companies (Model Articles) Regulations 2008. The company has issued ordinary shares only and has no shareholders’ agreement. Its most recent set of accounts show that the company did not make a profit or a loss in the most recent accounting period, although it has distributable profits of £50,000 carried forward from previous accounting periods. The shareholders want the company to declare a dividend out of these profits, but the directors intend to retain the profits within the company to finance an expansion of the company’s trade.
stemZh: 私人公司采用未经修改的2008年model articles，仅有普通股，无股东协议。最近年度不盈不亏，但以前年度结转可分配利润£50,000。股东想分红，董事希望留存利润扩展业务。
ask: Can the shareholders compel the directors to recommend a dividend?
askZh: 股东能否强迫董事建议分红？

options.en: Yes, because the directors have a duty to act in the best interests of the shareholders.
options.zh: 能，董事有义务以股东最佳利益行事。

options.en: Yes, because the shareholders have the power to require payment of a dividend by ordinary resolution.
options.zh: 能，股东可通过ordinary resolution要求付款。

options.en: Yes, because the shareholders have a right to receive a dividend if the company has distributable profits.
options.zh: 能，只要有可分配利润就有分红权。

options.en: No, because only the directors have the power to recommend the payment of a dividend.
options.zh: 不能，提出分红建议属于董事的权限。

options.en: No, because the directors can only recommend a dividend out of profits of the most recent accounting period.
options.zh: 不能，董事只能从本年度利润建议分红。

explanation.topic: Dividends · 建议与宣派
explanation.zh: 选D。按本题未修改的model articles，宣派股息须以董事建议为基础，股东不能仅凭普通决议或存在可分配利润就要求董事推荐分红。留存利润可用于业务发展。
explanation.ruleZh: Distributable profits ≠ 自动分红权；宣派受董事建议限制。
explanation.warning: 本题按既有章程机制回答，不是在讨论修改章程、罢免董事等另行治理措施。

A.zh: 促进公司成功不等于必须立即把利润分给股东。

B.zh: 普通决议宣派金额受董事建议限制。

C.zh: 可分配利润提供合法分红空间，不自动变成股东到期债权。

D.zh: 准确反映本题分红建议权限。

E.zh: 以前年度留存的可分配利润也可以作为分红来源。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Distributable profits ≠ 自动分红权；宣派受董事建议限制。

warning.zh: 本题按既有章程机制回答，不是在讨论修改章程、罢免董事等另行治理措施。

stem:
A sole trader, who operates as a builders’ merchant, enters into a contract with a company to hire a forklift truck. The terms of the contract are in writing and the sole trader is given the opportunity to read the contract in full before he signs it.

The sole trader does not read the contract but does sign it. The signature clause provides in bold and capital letters:

“I/WE HAVE READ THE CONTRACT IN FULL AND UNDERSTAND ITS TERMS.”

The contract states that the hire of the forklift truck is for a fixed three year term and that there is a fee payable to the company if the sole trader wishes to terminate it early (‘the Clause’).

The sole trader tries to return the forklift truck six months after signing the contract when he finds a cheaper alternative. The company requires the sole trader to pay the stipulated fee for early termination.

The sole trader then reads the contract. He claims that the Clause was not incorporated into the contract because he had not read it and had not dealt with the company before.
stemZh: 经营建材的个体商户向公司租叉车，获得完整阅读书面合同的机会，但未阅读即签名。签名条款粗体大写确认已阅读并理解。合同固定期限三年，提前终止需付费。六个月后商户找到更便宜选择想退车，公司要求付费。他此时才读到该条款，并称因未读且此前未交易，条款未订入合同。
ask: Was the Clause incorporated into the contract?
askZh: 提前终止费条款是否订入合同？

options.en: Yes, because the sole trader had signed the contract.
options.zh: 有，因为商户已签合同。

options.en: No, because the Clause was not specifically drawn to the sole trader’s attention before signature.
options.zh: 没有，因为签字前未被特别提醒。

options.en: No, because there was no previous course of dealing between the sole trader and the company.
options.zh: 没有，因为没有此前交易过程。

options.en: Yes, because the sole trader was acting in his capacity as a business not as a consumer.
options.zh: 有，因为他以经营者而非消费者身份行事。

options.en: No, because the sole trader did not read the Clause until some months after the contract was signed.
options.zh: 没有，因为几个月后才阅读。

explanation.topic: Incorporation by signature · 签字订入
explanation.zh: 选 A。提前终止费已经写在三年期租赁合同里，经营者有机会阅读，随后亲自签了字。即使他后来才读到这一条款，也不能仅凭“当时没看”否认条款已成为合同内容。双方是否曾经交易，在这里不是关键，因为本题已经有签署合同这一依据。
explanation.ruleZh: 签署合同文件通常受条款约束，即使未读。
explanation.warning: 如果签字是受到欺诈或虚假说明影响，结果可能不同；本题没有这些事实。

A.zh: 签字是本题条款订入的直接依据。

B.zh: 本题签署合同文件，不以对该条款另作提示为普通前提。

C.zh: 既往交易只是其他可能的订入方式，不是签字路径的必要条件。

D.zh: 商业身份本身不是订入依据，理由不足。

E.zh: 迟读不会自动推翻已发生的签字订入。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 识别订入方式
reasoningSteps.detail: 本题有正式书面合同，并由经营者签署；首先适用签字订入规则。

reasoningSteps.title: 检查有无例外
reasoningSteps.detail: 题目没有欺诈、虚假说明、非合同性文件或有效non est factum的基础。自己没有读，不属于例外。

reasoningSteps.title: 限定问题范围
reasoningSteps.detail: 因此提前终止费条款已订入，选A。订入不等于任何条款在任何情形都必然可执行；题目此处只问订入。

textbookReferences.chapter: 第6章 · 免责条款与不公平条款

Incorporation by signature

points.zh: 在有合同性质的文件上签字，原则上就接受其中的条款。对方给了阅读机会，而签字人自己选择不读，通常仍须承担签字的后果。

warning.zh: 如果签字是受到欺诈或虚假说明影响，结果可能不同；本题没有这些事实。

stem:
A local authority has statutory power to compulsorily purchase land for the purpose of building residential houses and access roads to the houses. The local authority approves a development plan and intends to acquire the land needed for the development plan by way of compulsory purchase. The development plan includes a new housing estate and a large cinema and shopping complex, with a dual carriageway passing through the new housing estate to provide the necessary access.

A local resident, whose land would be compulsorily purchased under the development plan, wishes to bring judicial review proceedings against the local authority to challenge the development plan.
stemZh: 地方政府有法定权力为建住宅及其通道征收土地。获批方案除新住宅区外，还包含大型影院及购物中心，并规划双车道穿过住宅区提供通道。一名将被征地的居民希望以司法审查挑战方案。
ask: Which of the following best explains whether the local resident can bring judicial review proceedings?
askZh: 该居民能否提起司法审查？

options.en: He can do so because the facts suggest the local authority may have acted illegally.
options.zh: 能，事实显示政府可能违法。

options.en: He cannot do so because planning decisions are not subject to judicial review proceedings.
options.zh: 不能，规划决定不受司法审查。

options.en: He can do so because the facts suggest the local authority’s actions may be procedurally unfair.
options.zh: 能，事实显示程序可能不公。

options.en: He cannot do so because proceedings cannot be brought by a single resident.
options.zh: 不能，单个居民不能提起。

options.en: He cannot do so because the local authority is acting within its statutory powers.
options.zh: 不能，政府在法定权限内行事。

explanation.topic: Illegality · 越权征地
explanation.zh: 选A。授权目的限于住宅与相关通道，而方案还以征收方式取得商业影院及购物中心用地，存在超越法定目的的 **illegality / ultra vires** 问题。直接被征地的居民也有明显利害关系。
explanation.ruleZh: 看授权目的、实际目的及二者差距。
explanation.warning: 司法审查可以针对法定权限错误，不必将每个不当决定都归到procedural unfairness。

A.zh: 授权范围与商业开发部分不匹配，支持越权挑战。

B.zh: 规划及征收决定并非普遍免受司法审查。

C.zh: 本题直接给出的缺陷是权限目的，不是程序事实。

D.zh: 单个有足够利害关系的居民可起诉。

E.zh: 忽略影院和购物中心超出题设授权的可能性。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 看授权目的、实际目的及二者差距。

warning.zh: 司法审查可以针对法定权限错误，不必将每个不当决定都归到procedural unfairness。

stem:
A private limited company is proposing to allot some ordinary shares to a man for a cash payment. The company only has ordinary shares in issue and has unamended model articles as set out in Schedule 1 to the Companies (Model Articles) Regulations 2008.

Once the allotment has been completed, the man will have 30% of the issued share capital of the company. He is not and will not become a director of the company.
stemZh: 私人公司只有普通股并采用未经修改的model articles，拟向男性现金配发普通股。完成后他持有30%已发行股本，且不会成为董事。
ask: Which of the following benefits will be conferred on the man by the allotment of shares?
askZh: 配股将赋予他何种利益？

options.en: The power to appoint additional directors.
options.zh: 可以自行任命额外董事。

options.en: A contractual right to dividends.
options.zh: 拥有合同上的分红请求权。

options.en: A right of first refusal if another shareholder wishes to sell his or her shares.
options.zh: 其他股东出售股份时享优先购买权。

options.en: The power to stop the company changing its name.
options.zh: 可以阻止公司更名。

options.en: Guaranteed repayment in full of all amounts paid up on the shares in the event that the company is wound up.
options.zh: 公司清算时保证全额收回实缴股款。

explanation.topic: Blocking a special resolution · 特别决议阻止权
explanation.zh: 选D。按题设公司更名通常需75%的special resolution。持股30%的普通股东若参与并投反对票，可阻止达到该门槛；他不因此取得单独控制董事任命或保证分红、返还本金的权利。
explanation.ruleZh: 超过25%的投票反对力量可阻止75%特别决议。
explanation.warning: 阻止会议决议要实际行使投票权；缺席不等于自动把30%计作反对。

A.zh: 30%不构成通常普通决议所需多数，也不是独立任命权。

B.zh: 分红还要有合法利润及有效宣派，不是保证支付。

C.zh: 法定新股配发优先认购与旧股转让优先购买不同；model articles不自动赋予后者。

D.zh: 30%反对票可阻止75%特别决议通过。

E.zh: 普通股承担剩余风险，清算无保证全额返还。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 超过25%的投票反对力量可阻止75%特别决议。

warning.zh: 阻止会议决议要实际行使投票权；缺席不等于自动把30%计作反对。

stem: A solicitor is instructed by a claimant in a personal injury claim. The matter proceeds to trial where the solicitor appears before a male District Judge in the County Court at a hearing centre which is located outside London.
stemZh: 律师代理人身伤害原告，在伦敦以外的County Court出庭，审判法官为男性District Judge。
ask: How should the solicitor address the judge?
askZh: 应如何称呼该法官？

options.en: Your Honour.
options.zh: Your Honour

options.en: Judge.
options.zh: Judge

options.en: Your Worship.
options.zh: Your Worship

options.en: Master.
options.zh: Master

options.en: Sir.
options.zh: Sir

explanation.topic: Judicial address · 法官称谓
explanation.zh: 选B。District Judge在本题应称 **Judge**。不要沿用旧有的Sir/Madam称谓，也不要与Circuit Judge的Your Honour混淆。
explanation.ruleZh: District Judge → Judge；Circuit Judge → Your Honour。
explanation.warning: 称谓看法官职级，不只看法院是否在伦敦或法官性别。

A.zh: 通常用于Circuit Judge，不是本题District Judge。

B.zh: District Judge对应Judge。

C.zh: 不适用于本题法官职位。

D.zh: 本题法官不是Master。

E.zh: 不是本题现行要求的称谓。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: District Judge → Judge；Circuit Judge → Your Honour。

warning.zh: 称谓看法官职级，不只看法院是否在伦敦或法官性别。

stem:
A buyer visits the premises of a caravan seller and sees a vintage caravan. The following day the buyer sends an email to the seller offering to buy the vintage caravan for £12,000, and the seller accepts the buyer’s offer by email a few minutes later. The buyer has not yet paid for the vintage caravan nor collected it.

Neither party is aware that the vintage caravan had been destroyed in a flood the previous night after a violent storm.
stemZh: 买方到露营车卖方处看中一辆古董露营车，第二天邮件出价£12,000，卖方几分钟后邮件接受。买方尚未付款或提车。双方均不知道该车在前一夜暴风雨引起的洪水中已被毁。
ask: Is there an enforceable contract between the seller and the buyer?
askZh: 双方是否有可执行合同？

options.en: Yes, because the rule of caveat emptor applies to the contract.
options.zh: 有，适用买者自慎。

options.en: No, because although there was an agreement between the seller and the buyer, the buyer has not provided any consideration.
options.zh: 没有，因为虽有协议但买方没有对价。

options.en: No, because the contract has been frustrated as the vintage caravan no longer exists.
options.zh: 没有，因为车辆不存在导致合同frustrated。

options.en: Yes, because there was an agreement between the seller and the buyer and the buyer has provided consideration.
options.zh: 有，因为有协议及对价。

options.en: No, because the contract is void for common mistake as the vintage caravan no longer exists.
options.zh: 没有，因为车辆不存在使合同因共同错误而无效。

explanation.topic: Common mistake · 订约前标的灭失
explanation.zh: 选 E。关键是房车被毁的时间：先发生洪水，第二天双方才通过邮件谈成买卖。因此，在双方表示同意时，这辆特定房车已经不存在，只是两人都不知道。这属于common mistake，合同自始无效；不是合同订立后发生事件所导致的frustration。
explanation.ruleZh: 成立前灭失：common mistake；成立后根本变化：frustration。
explanation.warning: 买方还没付钱，不等于没有对价。他作出的付款承诺本身就可以构成对价，所以B的理由不对。

A.zh: 买者自慎不能解决标的在订约前已经不存在的基础错误。

B.zh: 未付款不代表无对价，付款承诺即可构成对价。

C.zh: 时间点错误，毁损在合同成立之前。

D.zh: 一般成立要素不能克服本题根本共同错误。

E.zh: 正确识别订约前灭失及双方共同未知。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 先画时间线
reasoningSteps.detail: 夜间风暴毁掉房车在先，次日通过邮件要约与承诺在后；错误事实在订约时已存在。

reasoningSteps.title: 区分错误与受挫
reasoningSteps.detail: 双方共同误信特定房车存在，属于common mistake / res extincta。Frustration针对有效订约后发生的事件，不适合这条时间线。

reasoningSteps.title: 付款不是关键
reasoningSteps.detail: 承诺付款可以是执行中的对价；尚未付款不是无对价。决定答案E的是标的订约前已灭失，合同自始无效。

textbookReferences.chapter: 第9章 · 合同义务的解除
textbookReferences.section: 合同受挫的发生时点与效果：用于区分本题的共同错误
Common mistake；res extincta；错误事实须在订约时存在

points.zh: 订约时，双方都误以为那辆特定房车还存在，实际上它在前一晚已被洪水毁掉。这种关于交易基础的共同错误，使本题合同自始无效。
合同受挫处理的是合同有效成立之后，才发生的重大变化。本题房车先毁、合同后订，时间顺序不同。

warning.zh: 买方还没付钱，不等于没有对价。他作出的付款承诺本身就可以构成对价，所以B的理由不对。

stem:
A non-governmental organisation (NGO) was created under statute with responsibilities for providing free after-school activities for children of single parent working families from the most economically deprived cities in the UK.

It relies on central government for the bulk of its funding. Spending cuts in last year’s budget forced the NGO to significantly reduce the scope of its after-school activities. Seven months ago, it wrote to the parents of several children explaining that it would no longer be able to provide any after-school care for their children. It did not explain its decision beyond saying that the needs of some families were greater than others.

The parents have just applied to the High Court for permission to proceed to a full judicial review of the NGO’s decision but the High Court has refused the application.
stemZh: 依法设立的NGO为贫困城市单亲工作家庭儿童提供免费课后活动，主要依赖中央政府资助。预算削减后缩小服务，七个月前致函部分家长终止照护，只解释其他家庭需求更大。家长刚向High Court申请司法审查许可，申请被拒。
ask: Which of the following reasons would best justify this refusal?
askZh: 最能支持拒绝许可的理由是什么？

options.en: The NGO has responsibility for allocating limited resources and its decisions cannot be judicially reviewed.
options.zh: NGO分配有限资源的决定不能被司法审查。

options.en: The parents should sue the NGO for breach of contract instead.
options.zh: 家长应改诉违约。

options.en: The NGO is not part of the executive and as such is not a public body.
options.zh: NGO不属行政机关，所以不是公共机构。

options.en: The parents have not applied as soon as possible or within three months of the decision.
options.zh: 家长未及时、亦未在决定后三个月内申请。

options.en: The parents have no obvious substantive grounds on which to argue that the NGO has acted unlawfully.
options.zh: 家长没有任何明显实体违法依据。

explanation.topic: Judicial review time · 司法审查期限
explanation.zh: 选D。一般司法审查须promptly并且通常不迟于事由产生后三个月提出；等待七个月且无延期理由，是最明确的程序障碍。依法承担公共职能的NGO不因名称为非政府组织就必然免于审查。
explanation.ruleZh: 一般JR：promptly，且通常最迟三个月；另查特别期限。
explanation.warning: 三个月不是可以任意等满的保证期，法院仍可能认为更早就应提出。

A.zh: 资源分配有裁量空间，但不是绝对审查豁免。

B.zh: 题干未提供必须通过合同诉讼解决的基础。

C.zh: 是否行使公共职能比机构名称更关键。

D.zh: 七个月明显超过通常期限，且没有例外事实。

E.zh: 不能仅凭简短理由断言没有任何实体审查问题。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 一般JR：promptly，且通常最迟三个月；另查特别期限。

warning.zh: 三个月不是可以任意等满的保证期，法院仍可能认为更早就应提出。

stem:
A woman is given a new microwave as a birthday present from a friend. The friend had bought it from a local retailer. The microwave had been manufactured in China and then imported into the UK by a Welsh company.

When the woman is using the microwave, it bursts into flames due to faulty wiring. This causes the woman serious burns.
stemZh: 女性收到朋友送的新微波炉，朋友从本地零售商购买。微波炉在中国制造，由威尔士公司进口英国。她使用时，内部线路缺陷引发起火并造成严重烧伤。
ask: Which of the following statements best explains who could be liable under the Consumer Protection Act 1987?
askZh: 依据CPA 1987，哪些人可能承担责任？

options.en: The retailer only.
options.zh: 仅零售商。

options.en: The manufacturer only.
options.zh: 仅制造商。

options.en: The importer only.
options.zh: 仅进口商。

options.en: The retailer, the manufacturer and the importer.
options.zh: 零售商、制造商及进口商。

options.en: The manufacturer and the retailer only.
options.zh: 仅制造商及零售商。

explanation.topic: CPA defendants · 产品责任被告
explanation.zh: 选D。制造商和有关进口商属于可能承担CPA责任的主体；供应商在受害人适当要求后未能在合理期间识别制造商、进口商或上游供应商等法定情形下，也可能承担责任。题目问 **could be liable**，不是三者无条件都须赔偿。
explanation.ruleZh: 制造商、进口商可负责；零售商的责任需看法定识别义务等条件。
explanation.warning: CPA不要求伤者是原始买方；但不能误记“任何零售商都自动与制造商承担同样责任”。

A.zh: 忽略制造商及进口商责任。

B.zh: 忽略进口商及可能承担责任的供应商。

C.zh: 忽略制造商等其他主体。

D.zh: 涵盖法定可能负责的各类主体；零售商责任仍须满足条件。

E.zh: 无理由排除本题进口商。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 制造商、进口商可负责；零售商的责任需看法定识别义务等条件。

warning.zh: CPA不要求伤者是原始买方；但不能误记“任何零售商都自动与制造商承担同样责任”。

stem:
A solicitor is employed by a law firm. Neither the solicitor nor her firm are authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority to make financial promotions in accordance with the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 and associated secondary legislation (FSMA).

The solicitor takes part in a half marathon. At the end of the run the solicitor talks to another runner who admires the solicitor’s sunglasses. The solicitor explains that the sunglasses are manufactured by a private limited company in which she recently invested some of her own money. She explains that the company is now expanding its operations and is looking for further investment.

The runner states that he is considering investing in shares in a company that is involved in the fitness industry, and that he would be interested in learning more about the company with a view to investing in it.

The solicitor gives the runner details of the company and recommends that he considers shares in that company as a potential investment. The runner does not know that she is a practising solicitor.
stemZh: 律师与律所均未获FCA金融推广授权。律师参加半程马拉松后与另一跑者聊天，对方夸赞其太阳镜。她介绍制造商是自己投资的私人公司，正扩大业务寻找投资；对方表达投资健身行业的兴趣，她遂提供公司资料并推荐考虑其股份。对方不知道她是律师。
ask: Has the solicitor engaged in unlawful financial promotion in breach of FSMA?
askZh: 她是否实施FSMA禁止的金融推广？

options.en: No, because the solicitor’s communications were not made in the course of business.
options.zh: 没有，因为沟通并非在业务过程中作出。

options.en: Yes, because the solicitor’s communications amount to an inducement to engage in an investment activity.
options.zh: 有，因为构成参与投资活动的诱导。

options.en: No, because the solicitor’s communications are exempt as they relate to the purchase of shares in a body corporate.
options.zh: 没有，因为购买公司股份的推广获豁免。

options.en: No, because the solicitor’s communications are exempt as a solicited non-real time promotion.
options.zh: 没有，因为是获征询的非实时推广。

options.en: Yes, because the solicitor’s communications are not part of any other professional services provided to the runner.
options.zh: 有，因为并不附随为该跑者提供的其他专业服务。

explanation.topic: Financial promotion · 业务过程门槛
explanation.zh: 选A。FSMA金融推广限制要求相关沟通在 **course of business** 中作出。本题是比赛后的私人交谈，依给定事实不满足这一门槛；律师身份或个人持股不自动把私人聊天变成执业推广。
explanation.ruleZh: Financial promotion先查course of business，再查投资诱导与豁免。
explanation.warning: 本题结论基于私人聊天事实；有组织、带业务目的或报酬的招揽需另行分析。

A.zh: 准确抓住本题缺少业务过程这一条件。

B.zh: 即使有推荐，也不能省略course of business要求。

C.zh: 股份通常可涉及受监管投资，不能称一律豁免。

D.zh: 面对面互动是实时沟通，分类错误。

E.zh: 不附随其他服务并不会使纯私人交谈自动成为违法推广。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Financial promotion先查course of business，再查投资诱导与豁免。

warning.zh: 本题结论基于私人聊天事实；有组织、带业务目的或报酬的招揽需另行分析。

stem:
A solicitor in a firm believes that he has identified an opportunity to generate new work based on his personal experience of problems with his internet provider. The solicitor had signed a contract with an internet provider (‘the Provider’) for an ultrafast fibre-optic internet connection to be provided to his home. The Provider breached the contract by not performing the contract by the agreed date. The solicitor successfully negotiated significant compensation from the Provider.

The solicitor knows that some of his neighbours who live on the same street have also signed a contract with the Provider and may have experienced similar problems. He suspects that there may be other such neighbours who have also signed contracts with the Provider whom he does not know about. The neighbours include both a former client and current client of the solicitor.

The solicitor plans to write to all of his neighbours informing them of their potential legal claim against the Provider and offering them his services. A separate department within the solicitor’s firm will consider the provisions of data protection legislation, but the solicitor is considering whom he can contact without breaching his duty under the SRA Code of Conduct for Solicitors, RELs, RFLs and RSLs (‘the Code’).
stemZh: 律师因家用光纤供应商违约而成功协商到补偿，想向同街邻居推广类似索赔服务。有些邻居确定与同一供应商签约，另一些可能签过；邻居中包括其现任及前客户。律所其他部门另审查数据保护问题，他拟向所有邻居寄信介绍索赔并招揽业务。
ask: According to the Code, whom (if anyone) can the solicitor contact by letter?
askZh: 按SRA Code，他可向哪些邻居寄招揽信？

options.en: All of his neighbours.
options.zh: 所有邻居。

options.en: None of his neighbours.
options.zh: 任何邻居都不行。

options.en: His neighbours who he knows have a contract with the Provider only.
options.zh: 仅已知与供应商签约的邻居。

options.en: His current and former clients and his neighbours who he knows have a contract with the Provider only.
options.zh: 现任及前客户，加上已知与供应商签约的邻居。

options.en: His neighbours who are his current and former clients only.
options.zh: 仅属于其现任或前客户的邻居。

explanation.topic: Unsolicited approaches · 主动招揽
explanation.zh: 选E。SRA Code禁止未经请求向公众作法律服务招揽，但对current or former clients有相应例外。仅知道邻居可能有案可打，不会使未经请求的个别招揽成为允许行为。
explanation.ruleZh: Unsolicited approaches：本题例外为current / former clients。
explanation.warning: 职业规范允许联系，不意味着数据保护、准确宣传等其他要求不再适用。

A.zh: 认识邻居或共同问题不构成普遍例外。

B.zh: 忽略现任及前客户例外。

C.zh: 知道其与供应商签约不等于已有客户关系。

D.zh: 多加了不在例外内的非客户邻居。

E.zh: 准确限定本题例外范围。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Unsolicited approaches：本题例外为current / former clients。

warning.zh: 职业规范允许联系，不意味着数据保护、准确宣传等其他要求不再适用。

stem:
A private limited company has three directors. Two of the directors hold executive roles and are also shareholders. The third director is a non-executive director and has recently decided she wishes to resign as director.

The two executive directors have asked the third director to stay for at least a month in order to give them time to find a replacement. The third director insists she wants to leave straight away and submits written notice of her resignation to the company to take effect immediately.

The company has unamended model articles as set out in Schedule 1 to the Companies (Model Articles) Regulations 2008 (‘the Model Articles’).
stemZh: 私人公司有三名董事，其中两名执行董事兼股东，第三名非执行董事想立即辞职。其他两人希望她至少再留一个月寻找替代者，她仍向公司提交书面通知，明确即刻辞任。公司采用未修改的model articles。
ask: Can the third director resign with immediate effect?
askZh: 能否即刻辞任董事？

options.en: Yes, because a director can resign their office by written notice to the company to take effect at any time.
options.zh: 能，可书面通知公司并指定任何生效时间。

options.en: No, because the shareholders have not approved the third director’s resignation.
options.zh: 不能，股东尚未批准。

options.en: No, because a board resolution is needed to remove a director.
options.zh: 不能，罢免董事必须董事会决议。

options.en: Yes, because the third director does not have to make arrangements for any shares in the company to be sold.
options.zh: 能，因为她无须安排出售所持股份。

options.en: No, because the Model Articles require a director to give at least one month’s notice of resignation.
options.zh: 不能，model articles要求提前一个月通知。

explanation.topic: Director resignation · 董事辞任
explanation.zh: 选A。Model articles允许以通知方式辞任，按通知约定时间生效；本题书面通知即刻生效，无须股东批准。董事辞任与公司罢免董事是不同程序。
explanation.ruleZh: 辞任看通知及生效时间；辞任≠罢免。
explanation.warning: 另有服务合同可能涉及合同责任，但本题仅给出章程，没有约定通知期。

A.zh: 符合model articles的通知辞任机制。

B.zh: 本题无须股东批准辞职。

C.zh: 混淆辞任与罢免，且所述罢免程序也不准确。

D.zh: 是否另需处理股份不是董事辞任效力的基础。

E.zh: model articles没有本题所述统一一个月要求。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 辞任看通知及生效时间；辞任≠罢免。

warning.zh: 另有服务合同可能涉及合同责任，但本题仅给出章程，没有约定通知期。

stem:
A claimant based in England owns a national chain of pet shops. It has issued a claim for unspecified damages against one of its suppliers (the defendant) which is also based in England. The claim is in respect of dog toys which the claimant alleges were neither of satisfactory quality nor fit for purpose.

The claim form has been issued but has not yet been served. The claimant believes it needs more time to prepare the particulars of claim. The claimant wants to know whether the particulars of claim must be served with the claim form or if they can be served separately and what the time limits for service are. There are no grounds for alternative service, nor for any extension of time for service.
stemZh: 英格兰连锁宠物店已对同在英格兰的供应商发出未指定赔偿金额的claim form，尚未送达，争议为狗玩具质量及用途。原告需更多时间起草particulars of claim；没有替代送达或延长送达时间的理由。
ask: Which of the following statements correctly sets out the rules on service of the particulars of claim in these circumstances?
askZh: 诉讼请求详情可以如何送达？

options.en: The particulars of claim may be served within 14 days after service of the claim form, provided that the claim form is served on the defendant no later than four months after issue of the claim form.
options.zh: 可在claim form送达后14日内另行送达，只要claim form在发出后四个月内送达。

options.en: The particulars of claim may be served within 14 days after service of the claim form, provided that the particulars of claim are served on the defendant no later than four months after issue of the claim form.
options.zh: 可在claim form送达后14日内另行送达，但particulars本身最迟须在claim form发出后四个月内送达。

options.en: The particulars of claim may be served within 14 days after service of the claim form, provided that the particulars of claim are served on the defendant no later than six months after issue of the claim form.
options.zh: 可另行在14日内送达，但particulars最迟为发出后六个月。

options.en: The particulars of claim must be served at the same time as the claim form, and both the claim form and the particulars of claim must be served within four months of the date of issue of the claim form.
options.zh: 必须与claim form同时送达，两者最迟四个月。

options.en: The particulars of claim must be served at the same time as the claim form, and both the claim form and the particulars of claim must be served within six months of the date of issue of the claim form.
options.zh: 必须同时送达，两者最迟六个月。

explanation.topic: Particulars of claim · 双重送达期限
explanation.zh: 选B。可随claim form送达或其后14日内另行送达，但不得超过claim form适用的最终送达期限。本题境内送达采用四个月外部上限，不能临近届满才送claim form后再额外拿14日。
explanation.ruleZh: Particulars：14日以内，且不能越过claim form适用的最终期限。
explanation.warning: 两项限制同时满足；不能把四个月与14日简单相加。

A.zh: 只管claim form在四个月内，却遗漏particulars也受同一外部上限。

B.zh: 同时包含14日相对期限与四个月最终期限。

C.zh: 本题境内送达不采用六个月。

D.zh: particulars可另行送达，不一定同时。

E.zh: 既误要求同时，又误用六个月。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Particulars：14日以内，且不能越过claim form适用的最终期限。

warning.zh: 两项限制同时满足；不能把四个月与14日简单相加。

stem:
A partnership agrees to pay £15,000 to a company to hire a large hall in London for an exhibition on 1 March. £5,000 is payable on 14 February and the balance is due on 28 February. The partnership does not make the payment of £5,000.

On 26 February, the company spends £2,000 on contractors who set up the hall with equipment, tables, chairs and display boards.

On 27 February, a major water leak takes place at the hall, through no fault of the company. The contract is frustrated.

The partnership is concerned that the company may seek to recover a payment from it and takes legal advice on its potential liability.
stemZh: 合伙拟于3月1日以£15,000租伦敦大厅办展，£5,000应在2月14日支付，余款2月28日到期，但首款未付。2月26日出租公司花£2,000请人布置设备、桌椅和展板。2月27日无出租方过错的严重漏水使合同frustrated。合伙咨询可能仍须支付多少。
ask: What sum, if any, is it most likely a court will order the partnership to pay to the company?
askZh: 法院最可能命令支付多少？

options.en: £5,000, being the amount payable prior to the date of the frustrating event.
options.zh: £5,000，即事件前已到期金额。

options.en: £7,000, being the amount payable and the expenses incurred prior to the date of the frustrating event.
options.zh: £7,000，即到期金额加开支。

options.en: £13,000, being the total amount due under the contract less the expenses incurred prior to the date of the frustrating event.
options.zh: £13,000，即总价减开支。

options.en: £2,000, being the amount of expenses incurred prior to the date of the frustrating event.
options.zh: £2,000，即事件前已支出的费用。

options.en: Nothing, all monies due to be paid under the contract cease to be payable.
options.zh: 零，全部应付款均停止支付。

explanation.topic: Frustration expenses · 受挫前开支
explanation.zh: 选 D，£2,000。大厅漏水使合同受挫后，合伙原则上不必继续支付原先到期的£5,000。但出租公司在漏水前已为展览布置花了£2,000，法院可以酌情允许它收回这笔准备费用。由于£2,000低于受挫前已到期的£5,000，题目问“最可能判付多少”时应选£2,000。
explanation.ruleZh: 已付可退、应付停止；法院可在法定上限内允许受挫前开支。

A.zh: 已到期不代表事件后仍无条件必须付满。

B.zh: 不能把本已停止应付的£5,000再与开支累计。

C.zh: 不是以总合同价减开支来计算。

D.zh: 符合开支酌情补偿及金额上限。

E.zh: 忽略法院允许recover expenses的裁量。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 列出受挫前已到期款项
reasoningSteps.detail: 2月27日受挫，先前到期的是£5,000；£10,000尾款尚未到期。首款未付不妨碍检查其原本已到期的金额。

reasoningSteps.title: 先用基本规则
reasoningSteps.detail: 受挫前应付未付金额原则上停止支付；不能继续要求全额£5,000，也不能要求合同总价。

reasoningSteps.title: 再用开支裁量
reasoningSteps.detail: 法院可在相关已付或应付上限内允许受挫前开支。本题£2,000低于£5,000，上述费用最可能获准，故选D；这仍是裁量而非自动债权。

textbookReferences.chapter: 第9章 · 合同义务的解除
textbookReferences.section: The effect of frustration on financial obligations / claims for money
合同受挫前已支付款项、准备费用及法院裁量

points.zh: 合同受挫后，原本已经到期但尚未支付的款项，原则上不必再付。不过，对方在受挫前为履约花了钱，法院可以在法定上限内允许其收回部分费用。
本题受挫前已到期£5,000，实际准备费用为£2,000；£2,000没有超过上限，是最可能获准的金额。这是法院酌情决定的结果，不是花了多少就必定赔多少。

stem:
A man and a woman visit a theme park owned and maintained by a company. The man buys two tickets for them to gain entry. On the reverse of the tickets, the company has placed a disclaimer of liability for personal injury, which says: “No liability for death or personal injury howsoever caused.”

The woman goes for a ride on the rollercoaster. The carriage she is riding in becomes detached from its tracks because of negligent maintenance and she is thrown to the ground. She suffers personal injury and seeks advice from a solicitor about claiming compensation for her injuries. The solicitor considers whether a duty under the Occupiers’ Liability Act 1957 (‘the Act’) may exist.
stemZh: 男女到公司经营维护的主题公园，男性为两人买票。票背免责写“无论原因，不对死亡或人身伤害负责”。女性乘过山车时因维护过失导致车厢脱轨，跌落受伤。律师考虑OLA 1957。
ask: Which of the statements below best describes the company’s duty, if any, to the woman under the Act?
askZh: 公司对女性承担何种义务？

options.en: The company does not owe her a duty because of the disclaimer.
options.zh: 因免责条款而无义务。

options.en: The company owes her a duty to ensure its ride is safe.
options.zh: 有义务保证游乐设施安全。

options.en: The company does not owe her a duty because the ride is not premises under the Act.
options.zh: 无义务，因为游乐设施不属premises。

options.en: The company owes her a duty to ensure she is reasonably safe in using the ride.
options.zh: 有义务使她使用设施时合理安全。

options.en: The company does not owe her a duty because she did not buy a ticket.
options.zh: 无义务，因为她未亲自买票。

explanation.topic: Occupier’s common duty · 合理安全
explanation.zh: 选D。对合法访客的共同注意义务，是采取合理谨慎，使访客在获准使用范围内 **reasonably safe**。这不是保证绝无事故；她无须亲自付款，且本题人身过失免责不能排除责任。
explanation.ruleZh: 使访客reasonably safe；不是保证场地绝对safe。
explanation.warning: 区分合理注意义务与严格结果保证，并单独检查免责的法定限制。

A.zh: 所述免责不能消除本题过失人身伤害保护。

B.zh: 用绝对保证设施安全替换了法定合理安全标准。

C.zh: 法定premises范围并不排除本题设施。

D.zh: 准确表述合理谨慎与访客合理安全。

E.zh: 合法访客身份不以本人亲自购票为条件。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 使访客reasonably safe；不是保证场地绝对safe。

warning.zh: 区分合理注意义务与严格结果保证，并单独检查免责的法定限制。

stem:
A solicitor is employed to provide legal advice to the staff teams in the House of Commons. The solicitor is asked to prepare a note explaining the doctrine of Parliamentary Sovereignty, to be included in a guide for visitors to the House.

The solicitor considers some illustrations of Parliamentary Sovereignty, to explain how it can be said that Parliament is the supreme legal authority in the UK. He mistakenly includes an exercise of power which does not illustrate the doctrine.
stemZh: 律师为下议院工作人员起草给游客阅读的议会主权说明，误把一项不体现该原则的权力加入例子。
ask: Which of the following examples of the exercise of Parliamentary power has the solicitor mistakenly included?
askZh: 哪项被错误列入？

options.en: Parliament can regulate and change succession to the British throne.
options.zh: 议会可变更王位继承规则。

options.en: Parliament can modify or replace its own procedure for passing legislation.
options.zh: 议会可修改自身立法程序。

options.en: Parliament can pass entrenched legislation which cannot be repealed.
options.zh: 议会可通过永远不能被废除的固守性法律。

options.en: Parliament can pass legislation on matters that have been devolved to the Scottish Parliament.
options.zh: 议会可就已下放苏格兰议会的事项立法。

options.en: Parliament can pass legislation which has retrospective effect.
options.zh: 议会可制定有追溯力的法律。

explanation.topic: Parliamentary sovereignty · 不能约束未来议会
explanation.zh: 选C。按本题传统议会主权理论，议会不能使未来议会永远失去修改或废除法律的权力；其他选项体现议会广泛的立法能力。
explanation.ruleZh: 传统理论：可制定及废除法律，但不能永久束缚未来议会。
explanation.warning: 法律权力与政治惯例、通常做法不同；题目问的是主权理论。

A.zh: 可以依法调整王位继承规则，属于立法权表现。

B.zh: 可修改立法程序，符合本题一般理论。

C.zh: “永远不能废除”与不能约束未来议会冲突。

D.zh: 下放不消除Westminster最终法律立法权，政治惯例另论。

E.zh: 追溯立法法律上可能，虽常受政治或原则约束。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 传统理论：可制定及废除法律，但不能永久束缚未来议会。

warning.zh: 法律权力与政治惯例、通常做法不同；题目问的是主权理论。

stem: A firm of solicitors enters into a conditional fee agreement (‘the Agreement’) with a client. The client is the claimant in an action for damages for breach of contract (‘the Claim’) against a defendant. The Agreement provides that the claimant will pay her solicitors a success fee of 50% (‘the Success Fee’) if the Claim succeeds. On the advice of her solicitors, the claimant also takes out an after the event insurance policy.
stemZh: 原告就合同损害赔偿与律师订立conditional fee agreement，约定50%的success fee，并购买after the event保险。
ask: Which costs will potentially be recoverable by the claimant from the defendant if the Claim succeeds at trial?
askZh: 如果原告胜诉，下列哪些费用原则上可向被告请求偿付？

options.en: The claimant’s solicitors’ fees and disbursements, excluding both the Success Fee and the cost of the after the event insurance policy.
options.zh: 律师费及支出，不包括成功费及ATE保费。

options.en: The claimant’s solicitors’ fees and disbursements, including the Success Fee but excluding the cost of the after the event insurance policy.
options.zh: 律师费及支出，包括成功费，不包括ATE保费。

options.en: The claimant’s solicitors’ fees and disbursements, excluding the Success Fee but including the cost of the after the event insurance policy.
options.zh: 律师费及支出，不包括成功费，包括ATE保费。

options.en: The claimant’s solicitors’ fees, including the Success Fee but excluding their disbursements and the cost of the after the event insurance policy.
options.zh: 律师费及成功费，不包括支出及ATE保费。

options.en: The claimant’s solicitors’ fees and disbursements, including both the Success Fee and the cost of the after the event insurance policy.
options.zh: 律师费、支出、成功费及ATE保费。

explanation.topic: CFA costs · 可转嫁的诉讼费用
explanation.zh: 选A。本题普通合同索赔中，可按费用规则请求基本律师费和合理支出；success fee及ATE保费通常由原告自行负担，不能仅因胜诉转嫁给被告。
explanation.ruleZh: 普通合同案件：基本费用及支出可能获偿；success fee和ATE保费通常不可转嫁。
explanation.warning: 可请求偿付不等于必获全额；仍须考虑适用费用制度、合理性及法院命令。

A.zh: 正确区分基本诉讼费用与本题不可转嫁的融资附加费用。

B.zh: 成功费通常不能向被告收取。

C.zh: 本题ATE保费通常不能向被告收取。

D.zh: 既错误加入成功费，又一概排除了可赔支出。

E.zh: 胜诉不会使融资成本全部由对方承担。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 普通合同案件：基本费用及支出可能获偿；success fee和ATE保费通常不可转嫁。

warning.zh: 可请求偿付不等于必获全额；仍须考虑适用费用制度、合理性及法院命令。

stem:
A private limited company has four ordinary shareholders. Shareholder 1 and Shareholder 2 each own 30% of the company’s ordinary shares; Shareholder 3 and Shareholder 4 each own 20% of the company’s ordinary shares. The company has unamended model articles as set out in Schedule 1 to the Companies (Model Articles) Regulations 2008.

Recently, the shareholders all received proper notice of a members’ meeting. The meeting was convened to seek shareholder approval of a proposal to enter into a service contract with one of the company’s directors for a fixed term of five years. A request for a poll vote at the members’ meeting was properly made.

Only Shareholder 1 and Shareholder 3 attended the meeting, and no proxies were appointed by those not attending. When the resolution was put to the meeting, Shareholder 1 voted for it, giving his consent to the proposed five year fixed term of the service contract. Shareholder 3 voted against the resolution.
stemZh: 私人公司有四位普通股股东：第一、第二人各持30%，第三、第四人各持20%。公司采用未修改的model articles。公司在适当召集的股东会上表决批准一名董事五年固定期限的服务合同。仅第一、第三人出席，无委托投票，且已有效要求按持股数投票。第一人赞成，第三人反对。
ask: Has the shareholder resolution been passed on a poll vote?
askZh: 批准决议是否通过？

options.en: No, because the resolution was not approved by at least 50% of the company’s shareholders.
options.zh: 没有，因为未获公司至少50%的股东支持。

options.en: No, because the resolution was not approved by more than 50% of the company’s shareholders.
options.zh: 没有，因为未获公司超过50%的股东支持。

options.en: Yes, because the resolution was approved by more than 50% of votes cast by the shareholders attending the meeting and entitled to vote.
options.zh: 通过，因为出席且有权投票者所投票数中超过50%赞成。

options.en: No, because the resolution was not approved by more than 50% of the company’s shareholders attending the meeting and entitled to vote.
options.zh: 没有，因为出席并有权投票的股东人数中并非超过50%赞成。

options.en: Yes, because the resolution was approved by at least 50% of votes cast by the shareholders attending the meeting and entitled to vote.
options.zh: 通过，因为出席且有权投票者所投票数中至少50%赞成。

explanation.topic: Ordinary resolution · 实际投票多数
explanation.zh: 选C。超过两年的董事保证任期须股东普通决议批准。本次poll按股权票数：赞成30、反对20，赞成占实际投票60%，超过50%；未出席且未代理的股份不计入本次已投票分母。
explanation.ruleZh: 会议普通决议：more than 50% of votes cast；poll按投票权计算。
explanation.warning: 书面决议的分母另有规则；不要套用到本题现场会议表决。

A.zh: 不以全体股东人数或全部已发行股份作为本次会议已投票分母。

B.zh: 把全体公司股东而非实际投票作为基数。

D.zh: 本题为poll，不按出席者人头数计算。

E.zh: 门槛是超过50%，不是恰好达到50%；尽管本题实际达到60%，该规则表述不准确。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 会议普通决议：more than 50% of votes cast；poll按投票权计算。

warning.zh: 书面决议的分母另有规则；不要套用到本题现场会议表决。

stem:
A solicitor acts for a man who runs a shop and who is a defendant in a debt claim issued and served three months ago.

The man accepts that the claimant supplied and delivered goods to him and that the invoice for those goods of £14,000 remains unpaid. However, the man alleges that the goods were faulty and unfit for use and he was therefore unable to open his shop due to a lack of stock. He is bringing a counterclaim for the loss of profits incurred as a result. The counterclaim has a value of £12,000.

Both parties seek interest and costs. The trial estimate is half a day and neither party will be calling expert evidence.
stemZh: 供应商向商店索取£14,000未付货款。商店不争议发票金额，但称货物有瑕疵，因缺乏可售商品而无法开门营业，反诉£12,000利润损失。审判预计半天，无须专家；双方均请求利息及费用。
ask: Which track is the court most likely to allocate the case to and why?
askZh: 最可能分配至哪条审理轨道？

options.en: The intermediate track, due to the combined value of the claim and counterclaim.
options.zh: Intermediate track，因为诉请及反诉合计£26,000。

options.en: The fast track, due to the value of the claimant’s claim.
options.zh: Fast track，因为原告诉请为£14,000。

options.en: The small claims track, due to the estimated length of trial.
options.zh: Small claims track，因为审判少于一天。

options.en: The small claims track, due to the difference in value between the two claims.
options.zh: Small claims track，因为抵销后仅£2,000。

options.en: The fast track, due to both parties claiming interest and costs.
options.zh: Fast track，因为双方请求利息及费用。

explanation.topic: Track allocation · 诉请与反诉
explanation.zh: 选B。£14,000的合同诉请符合本题fast track的通常金额范围，半天审理且无专家也支持这一分配。不能机械将诉请与反诉相加或相减决定轨道，利息和费用不是这里提高估值的依据。
explanation.ruleZh: 分配轨道同时看诉请价值、复杂程度、预计审理时间等。
explanation.warning: 不要把反诉机械加总或抵销；反诉的实质和复杂性仍可影响分配裁量。

A.zh: 不是简单合计双方请求，再以总额决定轨道。

B.zh: 结合金额、时间及复杂性，fast track最适合本题。

C.zh: 审判短不使超过通常小额范围的诉请自动成为小额案件。

D.zh: 不能把争议反诉先抵销，按净额分配。

E.zh: 利息及费用不是本题采用fast track的决定依据。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 分配轨道同时看诉请价值、复杂程度、预计审理时间等。

warning.zh: 不要把反诉机械加总或抵销；反诉的实质和复杂性仍可影响分配裁量。

stem:
A 25 year old man is injured in a road traffic accident caused by a negligent lorry driver. The man is knocked unconscious and is taken to hospital. He does not regain consciousness as he has suffered serious head injuries. He remains unconscious for six months, after which time he dies of his injuries.

The man had been an avid football fan, attending all home and away matches of his local team. He was employed as a zookeeper.

The man’s mother, in her capacity as the executor of his estate, wishes to bring a claim in negligence against the lorry driver for compensation. She is correctly advised that the claim is likely to succeed and that the estate will be awarded damages to the date of the man’s death.
stemZh: 25岁男性在交通事故中被撞昏迷，六个月后死亡，期间从未恢复意识。他是足球迷，并受雇于动物园。他的母亲作为遗嘱执行人代表遗产请求死亡前的损害赔偿。
ask: For which of the following heads of damage will the estate recover compensation?
askZh: 遗产可以请求以下哪些损失？

options.en: Loss of amenity and loss of earnings only.
options.zh: 仅生活乐趣丧失及收入损失。

options.en: Pain and suffering, and loss of earnings only.
options.zh: 仅疼痛痛苦及收入损失。

options.en: Loss of amenity only.
options.zh: 仅生活乐趣丧失。

options.en: Pain and suffering, loss of amenity and loss of earnings.
options.zh: 疼痛痛苦、生活乐趣丧失及收入损失。

options.en: Pain and suffering only.
options.zh: 仅疼痛痛苦。

explanation.topic: Unconscious claimant · 意识与损害项目
explanation.zh: 选A。Pain and suffering要求相应主观感受，本题持续无意识，不能据此赔偿其未感受的疼痛。Loss of amenity则可客观体现失去正常生活能力；死亡前六个月的收入损失也可由遗产请求。
explanation.ruleZh: Pain是主观；amenity可客观；estate可追索死亡前收入损失。
explanation.warning: 本题问死者遗产的死亡前损失，不是家属的dependency或bereavement请求。

A.zh: 正确区分客观生活功能损失与主观疼痛，且包括死亡前收入。

B.zh: 错误加入无意识期间的主观疼痛，并遗漏生活乐趣损失。

C.zh: 遗漏死亡前六个月的收入损失。

D.zh: 错误加入本题不具感受基础的疼痛痛苦。

E.zh: 错误加入主观疼痛，同时遗漏其他两项。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Pain是主观；amenity可客观；estate可追索死亡前收入损失。

warning.zh: 本题问死者遗产的死亡前损失，不是家属的dependency或bereavement请求。

stem:
A woman owns a profitable business as a sole trader. She runs her business from the family home which is owned by her husband in his sole name. The family’s only source of income is from the woman’s business. The husband does not have a paid job, being the full time carer for the couple’s four children.

The woman needs to borrow £10,000 to expand her business. A family friend agrees to lend her the money, provided the woman’s husband agrees to guarantee the loan.

A meeting is arranged between the woman, the family friend and the husband. Before the meeting takes place, the woman stresses to her husband the importance to the family of getting the loan. The family friend’s wife and adult son also attend the meeting and hear the husband verbally agreeing to personally guarantee repayment of the loan. Following the meeting, the family friend makes the loan of £10,000 to the woman.

The woman cannot now repay the loan and the family friend wants to enforce the guarantee against the husband.
stemZh: 妻子在家经营获利的个体企业，是全家唯一收入来源；房屋由丈夫单独所有，丈夫没有有薪工作并全职照顾四个孩子。妻子拟借£10,000扩展生意，家庭朋友愿意出借，但要求丈夫担保。妻子在会面前向丈夫强调借款对家庭的重要性。会面时，家庭朋友的妻子和成年儿子也在场，听到丈夫口头承诺亲自担保还款。朋友随后放款。妻子现无法还款，朋友想执行担保。
ask: What advice should the family friend receive in relation to the guarantee?
askZh: 朋友能否执行丈夫的担保？

options.en: It is not binding because it must be evidenced in writing and signed by the husband.
options.zh: 不能，担保须有丈夫签署的书面证据。

options.en: It is not binding because it must be evidenced in writing and executed by the husband as a deed.
options.zh: 不能，担保必须书面并采用契据。

options.en: It is binding because it was freely given by the husband in the presence of two witnesses.
options.zh: 能，因为有两名见证人且丈夫自由作出。

options.en: It is binding because the giving of the loan was conditional on the giving of the guarantee.
options.zh: 能，因为担保是发放贷款的条件。

options.en: It is not binding because there is an irrebuttable presumption that the husband was subjected to undue influence by the woman.
options.zh: 不能，因为不可反驳地推定存在不当影响。

explanation.topic: Guarantee formalities · 担保书面证据
explanation.zh: 选 A。丈夫作出的guarantee，是保证妻子无法还款时由自己负责。法律要求这类保证有担保人签署的书面证据，才可向他执行。本题丈夫只是在会面时口头答应；即使两位证人都听见了，朋友也因此把钱借了出去，仍不能代替该书面要求。
explanation.ruleZh: Guarantee：检查由担保人签署的书面证据；不当然要求deed。

A.zh: 抓住担保须有担保人签署书面证据的形式要求。

B.zh: 不普遍要求担保必须制成deed。

C.zh: 证人不能代替法定签署书面证据。

D.zh: 贷款条件可解释交易安排，却不能消除形式要求。

E.zh: 夫妻关系及家庭压力不产生本题所述不可反驳推定。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 先识别承诺类型
reasoningSteps.detail: 丈夫保证妻子债务还款，承担secondary obligation，是guarantee。

reasoningSteps.title: 检查形式
reasoningSteps.detail: 要向丈夫执行，须有其签署的书面证据。这里只有口头保证及见证，没有符合要求的书面证据。

reasoningSteps.title: 排除其他路线
reasoningSteps.detail: 普通担保不一律需要deed；有见证、已放款或妻子强调家庭需要都不能替代本题书面要求。因此选A。

Guarantees的概念

textbookExample.title: 教材：银行贷款及他人保证
textbookExample.facts: 教材以银行借钱给借款人、另一人书面保证还款为例，区分借款人的首要债务与担保人的次位义务。
textbookExample.lesson: 保证义务的性质与书面形式要求须分别检查。
textbookExample.connection: 本题债务关系类似，但丈夫只有口头保证，缺少可执行的签署书面证据。

points.zh: 丈夫承诺“妻子不还，我来负责”，这是为他人债务提供保证。要向丈夫执行这一保证，须有由他签署的书面证据；只有口头承诺和现场证人不够。
担保不一律必须制成契据。本题缺少的是担保人签署的书面证据，不能把这一要求误记成“必须签契据”。

stem:
A Member of Parliament (MP) for the party in opposition makes a statement at a parliamentary select committee. In the statement he refers to evidence given to him by an undercover journalist which is critical of the working practices of a large company, which he names. The MP’s statement is reported widely in the press. The company’s response is that the journalist has wholly misrepresented its working practices. As a consequence, the company wants to bring defamation proceedings against the MP and the journalist.

The MP believes that he is protected from such a claim by parliamentary privilege. He contacts the Privileges Committee to clarify the position.
stemZh: 反对党议员在议会专门委员会中引用卧底记者证据，批评并点名一家公司。媒体广泛报道。公司拟就诽谤起诉议员及记者。
ask: Is the MP protected by parliamentary privilege for the statement he made at the parliamentary select committee?
askZh: 议员是否因parliamentary privilege而受到保护？

options.en: No, parliamentary privilege only covers statements made by MPs of the party in government.
options.zh: 没有，仅执政党议员享有保护。

options.en: No, parliamentary privilege only covers statements made in parliamentary select committees when national security issues are being discussed.
options.zh: 没有，仅处理国家安全的委员会受保护。

options.en: No, parliamentary privilege only covers statements made by ministers in response to specific questions in the House of Commons chamber.
options.zh: 没有，仅部长在下议院答询受保护。

options.en: Yes, parliamentary privilege covers all proceedings in Parliament.
options.zh: 有，保护适用于议会内的一切议事程序。

options.en: Yes, parliamentary privilege covers any statement made by an MP which arises from his work in Parliament, regardless of the setting.
options.zh: 有，议员在任何地方因工作作出的陈述均受保护。

explanation.topic: Parliamentary privilege · 议会程序
explanation.zh: 选D。议会言论特权保护proceedings in Parliament，包括专门委员会中的发言，不依党派或议题决定；但并非议员在任何场合的一切工作言论都享有同一保护。
explanation.ruleZh: 先定位是否属于proceedings in Parliament。
explanation.warning: 议员在委员会受保护，不自动决定记者自身发表行为或议员在外重复发言的责任。

A.zh: 保护并不按执政或反对党区分。

B.zh: 不限国家安全议题。

C.zh: 不限部长答询。

D.zh: 专门委员会发言属于受保护的议会程序。

E.zh: 把议会程序保护过度扩大到任何地点的议员言论。

stem:
A solicitor works in a litigation department at a firm of solicitors. She realises that two of her matters are listed for hearings of 30 minutes each, in the same court centre on the same morning, but before different judges. The first hearing is scheduled to start at 10.30am (‘the First Hearing’). The second hearing is scheduled to start at 11am (‘the Second Hearing’).

The solicitor intends to attend both hearings as she believes she would be the best person to represent the clients as she is familiar with both matters. She also believes that the First Hearing will finish early enough for her to get to the Second Hearing on time. She therefore wants to avoid increasing the costs for either client by instructing a barrister to attend one of the hearings.

The solicitor appears at the First Hearing. She finds that it takes longer than anticipated to persuade the judge to rule in favour of her client and the hearing lasts the full 30 minutes.

The solicitor is ten minutes late for the Second Hearing. The judge severely reprimands the solicitor for keeping numerous people waiting, indicating that he does not want to listen to her reasons for being late. After hearing arguments on the merits, the judge rules against the solicitor’s client. The judge makes a wasted costs order against the solicitor in respect of the time the other side were kept waiting until the solicitor’s arrival.
stemZh: 律师在同一法院大楼分别为两案出庭，时间为10:30和11:00，各预计半小时，由不同法官审理。她熟悉两案，想替客户节省另聘大律师费用，并预期第一案可能提前结束。第一案实际用满半小时，致第二案迟到十分钟。第二位法官严厉训斥、不听解释，作出对客户不利的实体决定并下令承担wasted costs。
ask: Was the solicitor in breach of the SRA Code of Conduct for Solicitors, RELs, RFLs and RSLs by being late for the Second Hearing?
askZh: 律师是否因迟到违反职业规范？

options.en: Yes, as she was wasting the court’s time.
options.zh: 是，因为浪费法院时间。

options.en: Yes, as her actions created a conflict of interest between her two clients.
options.zh: 是，因为存在客户利益冲突。

options.en: No, as she was acting in the best interests of her clients to save costs.
options.zh: 否，因为节省客户费用符合最佳利益。

options.en: No, as the court failed to give proper consideration to why she was late.
options.zh: 否，因为法官拒绝听解释。

options.en: No, as the court has sanctioned her behaviour with a wasted costs order.
options.zh: 否，因为已受wasted costs制裁。

explanation.topic: Court duties · 安排与法院时间
explanation.zh: 选A。律师应合理安排出庭并避免浪费法院时间，不能仅靠第一案可能早结束来承担相互挤压的安排。节费动机、法官态度或另行费用制裁均不消除相应职业义务。
explanation.ruleZh: 安排出庭要留出可行时间，并履行不浪费court time的义务。
explanation.warning: 熟悉案件及节省费用是考虑因素，不能代替可靠的时间安排。

A.zh: 迟到浪费法院时间，违反相关职业要求。

B.zh: 代理不同客户不自动构成实质利益冲突，本题重点是出庭安排。

C.zh: 服务客户同时仍须履行对法院的义务。

D.zh: 法官不听理由不使先前的不当安排变得合规。

E.zh: 法院费用制裁不排除职业规范责任。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 安排出庭要留出可行时间，并履行不浪费court time的义务。

stem:
A private limited company issued ordinary shares to five shareholders for nominal value on incorporation several years ago. Four of those shareholders are also directors of the company.

The fifth shareholder, a man, only has 10% of the ordinary shares. He has never been a director nor involved in the management of the company.

There have been no changes to the company’s share capital since incorporation.

The company has always made a profit and has distributed a large proportion of those profits annually to the shareholders.

This year the directors resolved to award themselves a substantial pay rise, far in excess of the market rate. As a result, the company made very little profit and no dividends have been declared by the directors this year.

The man consults a solicitor about what his remedy is likely to be if he is successful in an action for unfair prejudice under the Companies Act 2006.
stemZh: 私人公司有五名普通股股东，均以名义价值取得初始股份。四人兼任董事；第五人持10%，从未参与管理。公司过去经常以高额股息分配利润，现四名董事把自己薪酬提高至明显超过市场水平，导致无利润可分红。第五人的unfair prejudice申请成功。
ask: If the man is successful in an action for unfair prejudice, which of the following is the most likely remedy that will be ordered by the court?
askZh: 法院最可能给予哪种救济？

options.en: That the company buy back the man’s shares at fair value.
options.zh: 命令公司按公平价值购买该男子股份。

options.en: That the company buy back the man’s shares at nominal value.
options.zh: 命令公司按股份名义价值购买其股份。

options.en: That the man be appointed to the board with immediate effect and cannot be removed from office by the other shareholder directors.
options.zh: 把他任命为不可被罢免的董事。

options.en: That the company be wound up.
options.zh: 命令公司清盘。

options.en: That any future pay rises for directors be aligned with market rates.
options.zh: 命令公司未来所有加薪均按市场水平。

explanation.topic: Unfair prejudice · 股份买断救济
explanation.zh: 选A。成功的unfair prejudice申请可获法院灵活救济，本题选项中公平价值买断能使受损少数股东退出并补救利益侵害。原始名义认购价不等于现时公平价值，也不必直接清盘。
explanation.ruleZh: Unfair prejudice常见救济：fair-value buyout，具体买方及估值依法院安排。
explanation.warning: 法院救济裁量广泛；不能记成所有案件都必须由公司买回或必须清盘。

A.zh: 本题选项中最合适的公平买断救济；法院也可依案件安排由其他股东购买。

B.zh: 名义价值未反映公平价值，可能延续不公平损害。

C.zh: 不可罢免的董事职位不是本题通常适当补救。

D.zh: 清盘不是此处最可能的首选救济。

E.zh: 法院可作经营方面命令，但本题公平退出的买断更符合典型救济。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Unfair prejudice常见救济：fair-value buyout，具体买方及估值依法院安排。

warning.zh: 法院救济裁量广泛；不能记成所有案件都必须由公司买回或必须清盘。

stem:
A 17 year old motorist sustains a broken leg as a result of a road traffic accident when he is driving his car. The accident is caused by the negligent driving of the driver of the other vehicle (‘the Woman’).

At the age of 22, the motorist seeks legal advice for the first time from a solicitor as to whether he can bring a claim against the Woman for the injuries sustained in the accident.
stemZh: 男性在17岁时遭遇交通事故并腿部骨折，直到22岁才首次就人身伤害请求咨询律师。
ask: Which of the following represents the advice that the solicitor should provide to the motorist?
askZh: 按一般时效规则，他是否仍可在期限内提起诉讼？

options.en: A claim can be brought against the Woman because the limitation period is six years from the date of the accident.
options.zh: 可以，事故日起六年。

options.en: A claim cannot be brought against the Woman because the limitation period is three years from the date of the accident.
options.zh: 不可以，事故日起三年已经届满。

options.en: A claim can be brought against the Woman because the limitation period is three years from the date the motorist first seeks legal advice.
options.zh: 可以，从首次取得法律意见起三年。

options.en: A claim can be brought against the Woman because the limitation period is six years from the date of the motorist’s 18th birthday.
options.zh: 可以，从18岁起六年。

options.en: A claim cannot be brought against the Woman because the limitation period is three years from the date of the motorist’s 18th birthday.
options.zh: 不可以，从18岁起三年已经届满。

explanation.topic: Minor’s limitation · 未成年伤者
explanation.zh: 选E。人身伤害一般采用三年时效；受伤时未成年，通常从年满18岁起计算，至21岁届满。本题22岁才咨询，依题设一般规则已迟，不会因首次咨询重新起算。
explanation.ruleZh: 未成年PI：通常18岁起算三年，即21岁前启动诉讼。
explanation.warning: 一般期限已过不等于绝无任何例外；法院依第33条排除时效的裁量需另作判断，本题未给出该基础。

A.zh: 人身伤害不是一般六年合同请求期限。

B.zh: 忽略受伤时未成年导致的时效暂停。

C.zh: 找律师的日期不当然是法定起算日期。

D.zh: 正确注意到18岁，但错误采用六年。

E.zh: 18岁起三年，至22岁已逾通常期限。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 未成年PI：通常18岁起算三年，即21岁前启动诉讼。

warning.zh: 一般期限已过不等于绝无任何例外；法院依第33条排除时效的裁量需另作判断，本题未给出该基础。

stem:
A company enters into a contract with a supplier for the purchase of some bricks to be delivered to the company by a stated date (‘the Delivery Date’). The company’s terms (accepted by the supplier) state the time for delivery is: “of the essence” (‘the Term’).

Two weeks before the Delivery Date, the supplier tells the company that it will not be able to deliver the bricks by the Delivery Date.

The company seeks legal advice as it wants to immediately terminate the contract before the Delivery Date and buy the bricks elsewhere. The type of bricks ordered are only available from another source at a higher price. The company therefore also wishes to claim damages from the supplier.
stemZh: 公司与供应商约定在指定日期交付砖块，并明确交付时间为“time is of the essence”，供应商接受。交货前两周，供应商通知无法按时交付。公司希望立即终止合同，另以较高价格购买并索赔。
ask: Which of the following statements best represents the advice the solicitor should give the company?
askZh: 公司现在可以如何处理？

options.en: The contract can be terminated immediately and damages claimed from the supplier without having to wait for the Delivery Date to pass, as the Term is likely to be a condition.
options.zh: 立即终止并请求损害赔偿，因为供应商预期违反condition。

options.en: The contract cannot be terminated until after the supplier has failed to deliver by the Delivery Date but damages can be claimed immediately, as the Term is likely to be a condition.
options.zh: 只能交货日后终止，但现在可索赔，因为违反condition。

options.en: The contract cannot be terminated and damages cannot be claimed until after the supplier has failed to deliver by the Delivery Date, as the Term is likely to be a condition.
options.zh: 终止及索赔均须等交货日，因为违反condition。

options.en: The contract can be terminated immediately and damages claimed from the supplier without having to wait for the Delivery Date to pass, as the Term is likely to be an innominate term.
options.zh: 立即终止及索赔，因为预期违反innominate term。

options.en: The contract cannot be terminated until after the supplier has failed to deliver by the Delivery Date but damages can be claimed immediately, as the Term is likely to be an innominate term.
options.zh: 终止须等交货日但可立即索赔，因为违反innominate term。

explanation.topic: Anticipatory breach · 预期违反条件
explanation.zh: 选 A。合同特别强调交货时间“of the essence”，表示按时交付是关键条件。供应商提前两周明确说做不到，买方可以把这视为预期根本违约，立即通知终止合同，并就可赔损失提出请求。无须先等到约定交货日实际错过后，才能采取这些行动。
explanation.ruleZh: Condition + anticipatory repudiation：可接受违约、立即终止并索赔。
explanation.warning: 另找供应商时仍应采取合理措施控制损失。购买替代砖块多花的价差，并非不论金额和原因都能全额索赔。

A.zh: 正确识别condition及立即接受预期违约的权利。

B.zh: 不必把终止权延迟至原履行日。

C.zh: 接受预期违约后不必等待履行日才采取相应行动。

D.zh: 结果相近，但把明确时间条件误归为innominate term。

E.zh: 既误分类条款，又误延迟终止。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

reasoningSteps.title: 先判断条款地位
reasoningSteps.detail: 明定time is of the essence支持把按期交付认定为condition。

reasoningSteps.title: 再判断违约时间
reasoningSteps.detail: 供应商在到期前明确告知无法遵守，不只是已经迟延，而是anticipatory repudiatory breach。

reasoningSteps.title: 选择救济
reasoningSteps.detail: 公司可以接受违约，立即终止并请求可赔损失，无须等待交货日；合理替代采购差价须符合一般损害赔偿及减损规则，选A。

textbookReferences.chapter: 第9章 · 合同义务的解除
textbookReferences.section: Anticipatory repudiatory breach；conditions与解除选择
预期违约及继续履行或终止合同的选择
textbookReferences.note: 此页将预期违约后的主张写成“argue frustration”，该处表述有误。本题应分析预期根本违约及终止选择；Revise 第88–89页作了正确区分。

points.zh: 供应商在交货日之前就明确表示无法按时交付，买方不必一直等到交货日才处理违约。这里因为违反的是合同关键条件，可以接受该违约并立即终止合同。
合同特别约定按时交货是关键条件，使时间条款具有condition的地位。正是这一点支持立即终止；并非所有轻微延迟都允许终止合同。

warning.zh: 另找供应商时仍应采取合理措施控制损失。购买替代砖块多花的价差，并非不论金额和原因都能全额索赔。

stem: A man has recently qualified at the firm of solicitors where he was an apprentice solicitor. He will continue to be employed by the firm, working in the private client department where his work as a solicitor will involve drafting wills and obtaining grants of probate. He will also assist in the residential conveyancing department one day a week where he will assist on completions and post-completion work, including making applications for registration of the transfer of title documentation to the Land Registry.
stemZh: 新执业律师计划从事私人客户业务，包括起草遗嘱、办理遗嘱认证，并在住宅转让完成后向Land Registry登记产权转移。
ask: Which area(s) of the man’s work will be considered to be a reserved legal activity?
askZh: 其中哪些属于reserved legal activities？

options.en: Drafting wills only.
options.zh: 仅起草遗嘱。

options.en: Drafting wills and obtaining grants of probate only.
options.zh: 起草遗嘱及遗嘱认证。

options.en: Drafting wills, obtaining grants of probate and making applications for registration.
options.zh: 三项全部。

options.en: Obtaining grants of probate and making applications for registration only.
options.zh: 遗嘱认证及产权转移登记。

options.en: Making applications for registration only.
options.zh: 仅产权转移登记。

explanation.topic: Reserved activities · 遗嘱、认证与登记
explanation.zh: 选D。相关probate activities及办理本题产权转移登记的reserved instrument activities属于保留法律业务；单纯起草遗嘱本身并非保留业务。
explanation.ruleZh: 起草will与办理probate分开；本题土地登记属reserved instrument activities。
explanation.warning: 非保留业务仍可涉及专业规范和其他法律义务；这里仅作法定活动分类。

A.zh: 单纯起草遗嘱并非本题保留活动。

B.zh: 错误加入遗嘱起草，且遗漏产权登记。

C.zh: 把遗嘱起草也错误视为保留活动。

D.zh: 正确包括probate及本题土地登记活动。

E.zh: 遗漏probate activities。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: 起草will与办理probate分开；本题土地登记属reserved instrument activities。

warning.zh: 非保留业务仍可涉及专业规范和其他法律义务；这里仅作法定活动分类。

stem:
The leader of a pressure group has organised a procession through a busy city centre. In order to obtain maximum exposure whilst minimising disruption to the public, the procession will take place at 11am on a Saturday. The leader expects around 200 of his group’s members to attend.

Three weeks before the procession, the leader realises he has not notified the authorities that it will be taking place. He therefore writes a letter to the city council informing it of the date, time, route and the number of people he expects to be involved in the procession, and delivers this letter by hand the same day. The leader has included his name, address and telephone contact details in the letter.
stemZh: 压力团体计划于星期六11:00组织200人游行。三周前，组织人向市议会亲手递交书面通知，列明日期、时间、路线、人数以及姓名、地址和电话号码。
ask: Which of the following best explains whether the leader has complied with any legal requirements to give notice of the procession?
askZh: 该通知是否满足游行的法定通知要求？

options.en: Yes, the letter provides sufficient information to the appropriate authority and has been delivered in accordance with the deadlines.
options.zh: 满足，信息、接收机关及期限均正确。

options.en: Yes, the letter provides sufficient information to the appropriate authority and there are no deadlines for delivery.
options.zh: 满足，因为没有提交期限要求。

options.en: No, the letter has been delivered in accordance with the deadlines and to the appropriate authority but provides insufficient information.
options.zh: 不满足，接收机关及时间正确，但信息不足。

options.en: No, the letter has been delivered in accordance with the deadlines and provides sufficient information but has been delivered to the wrong authority.
options.zh: 不满足，时间及信息足够，但接收机关错误。

options.en: No, the letter provides sufficient information, but it has been delivered outside the deadlines and to the wrong authority.
options.zh: 不满足，信息足够，但期限及接收机关均错误。

explanation.topic: Public procession · 通知接收机关
explanation.zh: 选D。本题游行通知应交至起始地区适当的警察局，而不是市议会。三周提前量满足通常至少六个完整日的要求，题列日期、时间、路线及组织人资料也足够；缺陷是交错机关。
explanation.ruleZh: Procession notice：查警方接收、资料及通常六个clear days。
explanation.warning: 不要把申请市政场地或交通安排，与公共游行的警方通知混为一谈。

A.zh: 市议会并非本题法定接收机关。

B.zh: 法律设有通常的提前通知要求。

C.zh: 题列核心资料足够，问题是送达对象。

D.zh: 正确定位为接收机关错误。

E.zh: 三周并不迟于通常六个完整日要求。

explanation.source: SRA 官方答案表；中文解析为 AI 补充

points.zh: Procession notice：查警方接收、资料及通常六个clear days。

warning.zh: 不要把申请市政场地或交通安排，与公共游行的警方通知混为一谈。

stem:
A company (‘the Employer’) employs a man and a woman as builders. The Employer is carrying out the refurbishment of a hotel. The man and the woman are both working on the hotel refurbishment and their work involves erecting steel rods into the original ceiling to support it.

One day the woman arrives at the hotel site unfit for work, having consumed a lot of alcohol the previous evening. She installs one of the steel rods carelessly which results in part of the ceiling collapsing onto the man who suffers serious injuries.
stemZh: 公司受雇翻修酒店，安排一男一女两名员工安装支撑天花板的钢杆。女员工前一晚饮酒过量，次日不适合工作，操作钢杆时疏忽，导致天花板坍塌使男员工受伤。
ask: Which of the following best explains who the man can sue for compensation for his injuries?
askZh: 男员工可对谁请求赔偿？

options.en: The Employer only because it is solely vicariously liable.
options.zh: 仅雇主，且仅基于替代责任。

options.en: The woman only because she is solely liable in negligence.
options.zh: 仅女员工，基于她的过失。

options.en: The woman because she is solely liable in negligence and the Employer because it is both liable in negligence and vicariously liable.

explanation.topic: Employer’s liability · 自身义务与替代责任
explanation.zh: 选C。女员工因自身操作过失承担责任；雇主对提供适任员工及安全工作安排负有自身注意义务，并可对员工在职务范围内的过失承担vicarious liability。饮酒后不当履行工作，并不自动使其行为脱离职务范围。
explanation.ruleZh: 雇主责任分两条：personal duty + vicarious liability。
explanation.warning: 存在多个责任基础不意味着损失可以重复赔偿；仍须各自分析义务、违反及因果关系。

A.zh: 遗漏直接侵权员工及雇主自身义务的责任路径。

B.zh: 错误排除了雇主责任。

C.zh: 完整包含员工过失、雇主自身过失及职务内替代责任。

D.zh: 遗漏雇主对职务内员工侵权的替代责任。

E.zh: 遗漏雇主关于适任员工及安全工作的自身义务。
